title: Senior Consulting Engineer
description:
The team

MongoDB's Application Modernization Platform (AMP) organization is the front door of our modernization business. In our Data Migration practice we move production data - safely, repeatably, at enterprise scale - from relational estates (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and from NoSQL platforms (Apache Cassandra, Azure Cosmos DB, Amazon DocumentDB) onto MongoDB. We do this both as standalone migration programmes and as the data workstream inside larger application-modernization engagements, using MongoDB's own tooling - Relational Migrator, Cluster-to-Cluster Sync, Atlas Stream Processing - alongside the open-source and cloud-native pipeline ecosystem. 

Our mission is to help our customers be successful by leading end-to-end their journey to MongoDB. In an era where AI agents handle routine migration mechanics - such as workload assessments, schema and query translations, and large-scale validation - our consultants focus on the high-judgment decisions that directly mitigate risk. Joining us now means helping draft the playbooks while they are actively being defined. We are seeking builders who prefer creating new frameworks over following legacy instructions.

This role will be based remotely in Germany.

Position expectations

Delivery

- Plan and lead the technical delivery of data migration engagements end to end: source estate assessment, migration strategy and wave planning, schema and data-model transformation, pipeline build, validation, and production cutover with minimal downtime

- Design and operate change data capture (CDC) pipelines for zero and near-zero-downtime migrations - using Kafka and the connector ecosystem, Debezium and comparable log-based CDC tooling, and cloud-native replication services

- Bring genuine platform depth on the estates our customers are leaving: Cassandra data modeling and anti-patterns, Cosmos DB (Core and Mongo API) partitioning and RU economics, DocumentDB's compatibility surface - and use it to de-risk what the customer cannot see coming

- Work shoulder to shoulder with enterprise customers - architects, DBAs, platform teams and executives - from whiteboard to war room

- Own the full consulting lifecycle for your engagements, from planning and agenda-setting through post-engagement follow-up, surfacing risks and further opportunities back to Sales and Professional Services

Pre-sales and growth

- Partner with Solutions Architects, Engagement Managers and account teams to scope and size migration opportunities, shape statements of work and estimation models, and give sales well-founded confidence in what is achievable and what it will take

- Cultivate your reputation as a migrations SME and trusted advisor, internally and in the market, and positively influence your own utilization through proactive customer engagement

- Identify services opportunities in our customers, new workloads or estates to be migrated or product improvements the customer could benefit from

Building the practice

- Build and harden the AI tooling that makes migrations faster and safer: agents for automated estate assessment, schema and data-model conversion, query and code translation, and large-scale data validation - and fold what works into the standard delivery methodology

- Turn field experience into reusable assets: migration playbooks, reference architectures, estimation models, tooling improvements and enablement for the wider team

- Partner with Product and Engineering to bring field reality into MongoDB's product and migration-tooling roadmap

Candidate profile

- Professional fluency in German is required

- Excellent analytical, diagnostic and problem-solving skills, and the composure to apply them during a production cutover

- Degree in Computer Science or a similar technical field, and a technology-first mindset that lets you build credibility with some of the smartest technologists in the world

- 5+ years in software engineering, data engineering, or consulting delivery roles centred on data platforms and data movement at production scale

- Hands-on experience with at least one of: Apache Cassandra, Azure Cosmos DB, Amazon DocumentDB, or another distributed NoSQL platform - deep enough to reason about data models, consistency, partitioning and failure modes, not just operate one

- Real-world CDC and streaming-pipeline experience: Kafka or Confluent Platform, connectors, Debezium or equivalent, schema evolution, exactly-once versus at-least-once trade-offs, backfill-plus-tail patterns

- Solid grounding in relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL or MySQL) and in getting data out of them without breaking the business

- Competence in at least one programming language (Java, Python, Node.js, C#, Go or similar) - enough to build pipeline glue, validation harnesses and tooling, not only to configure products

- Working fluency with AI in real engineering workflows

- Excellent customer interaction and presentation skills: you can explain a partitioning strategy to a DBA at 10:00 and a migration risk profile to a Senior Leadership at 11:00, and both leave more confident than they arrived

- An entrepreneurial bias. You see the gaps and what is missing. You are comfortable operating where the process does not exist yet, and you would rather ship a rough first version and iterate than wait for the shape to be agreed

MongoDB expertise is not a requirement. We will teach you MongoDB - that is the part we are world-class at. What we cannot teach is the scar tissue from the platforms and pipelines above. Bring that.

Nice to have

- Experience building with LLMs beyond personal productivity: you use LLMs and coding agents as part of how you build and deliver today

- Migration or replication tooling experience: Spark or Flink-based pipelines, dual-write patterns, cloud DMS-class services, data-validation frameworks

- One or more cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) at architecture depth

- Experience on the vendor or consulting side of competitive platform displacements

- Practical experience with MongoDB

- Fluency in a second European language relevant to this market

Practicalities

Travel up to approximately 30% in normal circumstances, primarily within EMEA.

title: Senior Category Manager, Womenswear UK/EU
description:
ABOUT QUINCE 

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE 

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

- We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.

- Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 

- Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE 

Senior Category Manager, Women's UK/EU 

We are seeking a Senior Category Manager, Women's UK/EU to join our growing team. This role is suited to a data-driven product obsessed all-rounder. It supports the execution of merchandising strategy across selected womenswear categories, with responsibility for driving regional performance through strong product execution, trading, and customer insight. In this role, you will play a key part in scaling Quince’s value proposition in the UK & EU by delivering a compelling regional assortment, optimizing the customer experience, and partnering cross-functionally to bring high-quality products to market.

Responsibilities 

- Support end-to-end merchandising for selected womenswear categories in the UK & EU, including assortment execution, launches, and performance tracking

- Execute regional merchandising strategy in partnership with US Product Merchandising and international regional merchandising peers

- Contribute to product ideation, helping shape new product opportunities and business cases

- Work cross-functionally with Product and Regional Merchandising, Planning, Marketing, Technical Design, and Sourcing to deliver successful product launches—balancing inventory, go-to-market execution, and product quality (fit, sizing, and margin)

- Analyse trading performance (sales, returns, margin) and take ownership of actions to improve results

- Support pricing and assortment decisions for the region

- Own product catalogue management and administration, including product setup, data accuracy, and system maintenance

- Build site merchandising strategy, including PDP improvements roadmap and customer journey optimisations

- Monitor ratings, reviews, and returns to identify and support product quality improvements

- Manage regional product samples and merchandising assets

- Maintain merchandising reports, tools, trackers, and pricing files

- Take ownership of evaluating regional product compliance requirements and partner with Sourcing and Quality teams to execute

Qualifications required: 

- Role is based in one of our UK/EU offices (London, Madrid, or Berlin), with 4 days per week in-office requirement

- 8 years of retail merchandising or buying experience in womenswear categories, with demonstrated ownership of category performance

- E-commerce and/or DTC experience, with exposure to both startup and established (blue-chip) brands preferred

- Proven track record of progressing within an organization and demonstrating continuous growth in roles and responsibilities

- Strong product awareness, with a commercial mindset and attention to detail

- Product obsessed, with experience leveraging data tools and external sources to drive results

- Critical eye to anticipate customer needs (both the “science” and “art” of retail merchandising)

- Strong analytical skills, with experience using data to inform trading and merchandising decisions (e.g. sales, margin, return rates)

- Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in both executional and strategic support roles

- Experience working cross-functionally with teams such as Planning, Design, Sourcing, or Marketing

- Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills with particular ability to influence through concise written narrative

- Motivated by working in a fast-paced collaborative environment, where flexibility to stretch into or out of functional comfort zones is crucial for team success

- Adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity and change

- Bachelor’s Degree, preferred

WHY QUINCE? 

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY 

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. 

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form . We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds 

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

title: Sales Executive, DACH
description:
About Andercore 

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

- Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

- Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

- 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

- $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

We offer a highly competitive compensation package with On-Target Earnings (OTE), designed to reward high performance and results. This includes a strong base salary complemented by an uncapped commission structure , meaning there is no limit to what you can earn — your success directly drives your income. Top performers have the opportunity to significantly exceed OTE, supported by a transparent, performance-driven bonus plan that truly rewards achievement.

Building on this performance-driven culture, not every candidate ticks every box — and that’s why we value individuals with a growth mindset who bring potential, initiative, and a willingness to learn.

What you will do 

- Build and develop your own client portfolio by identifying and acquiring new business opportunities within your assigned market.

- Build and maintain strong relationships with clients to foster long-term partnerships.

- Proactively qualify new leads through daily outbound calls, follow-ups, and consistent pipeline management.

- Engaging in conversations with potential and existing clients, and guiding them through the sales process.

- Work closely with the technology team to provide feedback on platform functionality and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

- Collaborate with both buyers and suppliers to address any issues, inquiries, or challenges that may arise during the trading process.

- Monitor your performance against monthly targets and KPIs, taking ownership of revenue growth within your portfolio.

- Stay informed about market trends, product demand, and industry dynamics to make informed trading decisions.

Who you are 

- You have prior experience in Business Development, Sales, Key Account Management, or Account Management

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- You demonstrate excellent German skills and strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic work environment.

- A basic understanding of national and international trade and supply chain management is a plus.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description:
At CesiumAstro , we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team. 

We are looking to add a Senior Mechanical Engineer to our Mechanical Engineering team. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing space hardware for leading-edge communications satellites, we would like to hear from you. 

In this position, you will be responsible for mechanical design aspects of Cesium phased array antennas, subsystems, and interfaces through all phases of the development process. The ideal candidate will be versatile and proficient in mechanical analysis, electronics packaging, computer-aided design (CAD), mechanical interfaces, thermal architecture, spacecraft propulsion, deployable and actuated structures, and environmental qualification of spacecraft antennas and payloads. You will be responsible for mechanical designs from concept through space flight including requirements definition, architecture trades and block diagrams, analysis, manufacturing, testing, qualification, and in-orbit support. 

The successful candidate will also present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team, as well as participate in proposal-writing efforts. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required. 

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS 

- Bachelor of Science (BS) in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering from an accredited university or institution 

- Minimum of 5 years of experience in space antenna and payload mechanical engineering to include electronics packaging, thermal, shock, vibration, stress dynamics, and cost. A Master's degree may count as two years of experience. 

- Experience in conducting architectural trade studies including parametric and first-order cost and physical analysis 

- Experience with professional mechanical and FEA CAD tools, such as Ansys Mechanical, SolidWorks Simulation, and Thermal Desktop 

- Experience with CNC manufacturing and GD&T 

- Experience with advanced aerospace manufacturing and materials including sandwich panels and carbon composites, OR experience with high-reliability deployment mechanisms for space applications (including deployment, HDRMs, power delivery, etc.).

- Proficiency in detailed mechanical design (3D CAD, drawings, etc.) 

- Experience designing and manufacturing mechanisms and mechanical actuators 

- Experience with EMI/EMC mitigation techniques 

- Familiarity with satellite thermal architectures including heat pipes, phase change materials, contact resistance, and surface finishes as well as fundamental understandings of orbital thermal control in a LEO environment. 

- Familiarity with launch and LEO environments (thermal, shock, vibe, radiation, etc) 

- Familiarity with design for test, manufacturability, assembly, and reliability 

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills 

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE 

- Python, C++, or other programming languages 

- Experience with large, deployable antenna arrays which drive your vision for the next generation of on-orbit communications and sensor arrays.

- Robotics and control systems experience 

- PCBA experience.

CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills.

Please be aware that many roles will be subject to both security and export control restrictions. These restrictions mean that factors including new starter’s nationality, any previous or dual nationalities held, place of birth and country of residence may limit those roles that you can perform for the organization. 

Please note: CesiumAstro does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. title: Sales Manager
description:
Win new restaurants across Germany and help build one of our fastest-growing markets from the ground up.

Full-time

About SOUS 

SOUS exists to give independent restaurants the same acquisition-to-retention infrastructure that only chains and delivery platforms could previously afford. We build it as one connected data layer, replacing the fragmented stack most restaurants run today: a listings tool here, a separate storefront there, and no CRM at all.

Spotlight owns discovery, as search shifts from Google links to AI assistants recommending where to eat. Commerce owns the transaction and, critically, the guest relationship that marketplaces have been extracting for a decade. Every order through that owned channel generates data that sharpens the next cycle of visibility, personalisation and retention, compounding in the restaurant's favour instead of the platform's.

Our long-term bet is simple. As AI becomes the default interface for "where should I eat", the restaurants that own their guest data and their presence in that layer will keep the margin, and the ones still renting both from marketplaces will not. We are building the infrastructure to make the first outcome the default, not the exception.

We are a team of 27, working from our headquarters on the Vijzelstraat in Amsterdam city centre, and we are growing fast across the Netherlands, Germany and South Africa.

About the role 

SOUS helps independent food and beverage entrepreneurs grow by building what we believe will be the last employee a restaurant owner ever has to hire that touches a screen. After a strong start in the Netherlands, Germany is now one of our most important growth markets, and we are scaling our team there quickly.

As Sales Manager Germany you bring SOUS to independent restaurants across the country. You are one of the first people building our German sales team, which means real ownership, a big market to win and a fast track to grow with it.

Your team 

You join the Sales team Germany and report to the Sales Lead Germany, as part of the international sales organisation led by our Global Head of Sales. You work closely with our teams in Amsterdam across Growth, Partnerships and Merchant Success.

Tasks

Your role in this growth 

- Focus fully on new business and drive consistent growth in the single and multi-outlet restaurant segments in Germany

Key responsibilities 

- Build and manage a strong outbound and inbound pipeline in the German food and beverage market

- Run consultative sales conversations with chefs and restaurant owners, remote and on site

- Convert both hot and cold leads into qualified opportunities and closed deals

- Manage the entire sales cycle, from prospecting through to onboarding

- Share local market insights with marketing and product, from Lieferando dynamics to regional differences

Requirements

- 2 to 6 years of sales experience; a SaaS, hospitality or startup background is preferred

- Strong communication skills with a consultative, solution-oriented approach

- Comfortable working with targets, CRM workflows and structured outreach

- Affinity with the food and beverage sector, AI and digital products

- An existing network in the German restaurant or food and beverage industry is a plus

- Native or fluent German and good English

- Willing to travel for merchant visits and regular team days in Amsterdam

Benefits

title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI/ML Engineer based in Germany. 

Join a mission-driven engineering team developing practical AI systems that address real-world challenges in healthcare, agriculture, education, and international development. As an AI/ML Engineer, you will design, build, evaluate, deploy, and continuously improve AI-powered applications used by nonprofit organizations and their communities. You will work on solutions ranging from clinical copilots and AI coaching tools to agricultural advisory chatbots and evaluation infrastructure. Collaborating with behavioral scientists, researchers, and embedded engineers, you will translate applied AI research into reliable, scalable products and reusable technical resources. You will also help partner organizations strengthen their own AI capabilities through mentorship, open-source contributions, and knowledge sharing. This fully remote role offers substantial technical ownership and the opportunity to apply advanced AI engineering to initiatives that can improve outcomes for millions of people.

Accountabilities: 

In this role, you will build and improve production-ready AI systems while helping nonprofit partners adopt effective, measurable, and responsible AI practices. Your work will combine hands-on engineering, applied research, experimentation, and collaboration with teams working directly in the field.

- 
Design, build, evaluate, deploy, and improve machine learning systems and AI-powered applications for real-world use cases.

- 
Contribute to open-source AI evaluation infrastructure and tools that help nonprofit organizations assess and improve their AI products.

- 
Work closely with behavioral scientists, researchers, and field teams to identify recurring challenges and translate findings into reusable tools, frameworks, playbooks, and technical publications.

- 
Develop rigorous evaluation methods for AI systems, including appropriate datasets, evaluation criteria, and measurable performance improvements.

- 
Build and iterate on production-grade LLM applications and agentic systems, improving their reliability, usefulness, and performance for intended users.

- 
Release meaningful technical innovations from partner projects as open-source contributions whenever appropriate.

- 
Deliver solutions through rapid development and deployment cycles, using experimentation and measurable feedback to guide improvements.

- 
Document technical decisions, maintain engineering standards, and ensure AI components remain reliable and maintainable.

- 
Monitor developments in applied AI research, assess relevant advances, and test promising approaches in practical settings.

Advise and support nonprofit organizations developing generative AI products, helping them adopt effective engineering practices, tools, and workflows.

- 
Mentor partner organization staff and help strengthen their internal technical capabilities and responsible AI practices.

The ideal candidate combines strong machine learning fundamentals with substantial hands-on experience delivering end-user AI products. Strong foundations in mathematics, deep learning, large language models (LLMs), and modern AI systems.

- 
At least 1–2 years of experience building LLM-powered applications, including at least one production-grade agent beyond a proof of concept.

- 
Practical experience evaluating AI systems, with a strong understanding of dataset design, evaluation methodology, and performance measurement.

- 
Proficiency in Python and a willingness to remain deeply involved in hands-on implementation.

- 
Fluency in prompting and context engineering for agentic systems, including the ability to determine whether a problem requires improved prompting, a different model, better tools, or changes to the overall pipeline.

Experience using AI coding agents to produce high-quality work, with the judgment and accountability to validate outputs and take responsibility for what you ship.

- 
Ability to read research papers, assess new ideas, and quickly test relevant approaches through practical experimentation.

- 
An experimental mindset, with the ability to reason carefully about data, models, and evaluation while making iterative, measurable progress.

- 
Strong first-principles thinking and the ability to design practical, scalable solutions.

- 
A user-focused approach that prioritizes whether a product works effectively for its intended audience.

- 
Proactive ownership, urgency, attention to detail, and the ability to carry projects through to completion without constant direction.

- 
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to nonengineering audiences.

- 
A commitment to responsible AI development and technology that delivers meaningful social benefits.

Bonus qualifications: 

- 
Experience with multilingual natural language processing or low-resource languages, particularly Swahili, Hindi, and languages spoken across East Africa and South Asia.

- 
Previous work in global health, international development, or social-impact technology.

- 
Familiarity with behavioral science or AI applications designed to support behavior change.

title: Senior Technical Recruiter
description:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability 

At Hypersonica , we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.

As our Senior Technical Recruiter you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.

We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

What you'll do 

- Work directly with the Head of Talent day to day, with close access to the CEO, CTO, and technical heads

- Own hiring in Germany end to end, from role definition and sourcing through to closing and signed offers

- Turn senior leadership priorities into a capability based hiring plan and sequencing that matches delivery reality

- Partner with hiring managers to define what “great” looks like, set the bar, and build structured interview loops and scorecards

- Build targeted sourcing strategies for top tier engineers and operators across our core disciplines, with a focus on defence grade talent

- Run tight pipeline management in Lever, keeping data clean, stages meaningful, and momentum high

- Drive a fast, high signal candidate experience with clear comms, short loops, and decisive feedback

- Bring market intelligence back to leadership on availability, compensation, competing offers, and how to win in the German market

- Protect talent density by calibrating relentlessly, referencing properly, and holding the line on quality

- Improve the system over time, talent maps, sourcing playbooks, referral motion, and post hire retrospectives so UK recruiting compounds every month

Who you are 

- Senior technical recruiter, full life cycle, with a track record of filling genuinely hard technical roles

- You have experience recruiting in defence or a closely related high trust environment such as aerospace, space, advanced manufacturing, autonomy, or deep tech hardware

- You understand the realities of secure hiring, export controls, and discretion, and you can operate professionally around sensitive programmes

- You’ve worked in a high growth startup environment before, ideally Series A or similar, and you enjoy the pace and the lack of safety rails

- You treat recruiting as a strategic function, not an admin service, and you’re comfortable challenging briefs and sharpening the bar

- You can take a messy need and turn it into a crisp role, clear success outcomes with scorecards

- You can proactively source top tier talent and build pipelines, not just manage inbound applicants

- You communicate directly, move fast, and you like being accountable for outcomes

title: Publishing Product Director

As Publishing Product Director , you are the creative custodian of one of Crytek’s games, embedded inside the game team, accountable for protecting the creative vision and translating the promise of the game into work that the publishing team can execute with conviction. The success of a great game depends on the work that surrounds it landing as truthfully as the game itself, and closing that gap is what this role exists to do. You make sure that what reaches players is authentic, aspirational, tells the story the game deserves, and delights the players who play it. 

The game in your remit is an unannounced project in the Crytek portfolio. The work focuses on shaping the project’s player promise from the inside out, defining the publishing narrative for its eventual reveal, and carrying its creative vision through to launch and into ongoing releases. 

You sit inside the game team, working shoulder-to-shoulder with game leadership every day. You partner directly with the Chief Publishing Officer and Brand & Marketing Director to support both the game and the business as one connected effort. You are the direct line between the game team and the publishing organization, the person who protects the north star on both ends, and the person both sides trust to tell them the truth. 

This role demands creative conviction, drive, and the kind of experience that only comes from working shoulder-to-shoulder with game teams. You will protect the team from noise so they can build the game, and you will give the publishing team the clarity, player insight, and creative truth they need to land it well. It is one of the most consequential seats at Crytek, and one of the most rewarding. 

What You'll Do 

- Be the custodian of the game’s creative vision, tone, and player promise, and translate it into work that publishing can execute with conviction

- Partner with the Chief Publishing Officer and Brand & Marketing Director to shape go-to-market plans that serve the game and the business in equal measure 

- Drive franchise narrative, player promise, and creative direction across reveals, beats, and post-launch moments 

- Protect the game team from operational noise so they can focus on building, while translating publishing priorities into work the team can act on 

- Keep the north star intact on both ends, keeping publishing grounded in the game’s vision, and the game team grounded in player and market reality 

What You Bring 

- 8+ years working at the seam between game development and publishing or marketing, with significant time embedded inside game teams 

- Proven ability to translate creative vision into commercial activation without compromising either side, with strong creative judgement and editorial instinct you can defend under pressure 

- Fluency across business models (premium, live service, DLC, F2P) and multi-year roadmap strategy, and how the two shape the player promise 

- Cross-functional leadership and the ability to influence without authority across game and publishing teams 

- Strong player insight, audience segmentation, and community fluency 

- Drive and operating range, comfortable moving from creative critique in the morning to commercial trade-offs in the afternoon 

- Experience supporting or launching at least one major game or live-service title from inside the game team 

- Track record of being trusted by both game leadership and publishing leadership 

What you can expect from us

Company Apartment

Public Transport Pass

Gym Card 

A healthy body is a healthy mind. We offer a membership at the premium gym chain Fitness First in Germany. Work out, join group fitness classes, or relax in the wellness facilities.

State-of-the-art Office 

We’ve recently moved into a brand-new, modern office located in the heart of Frankfurt. Our new workspace is designed to inspire creativity and collaboration, with open areas, quiet zones, and top-tier facilities — all just steps away from public transport, restaurants, bars and cultural hotspots.

Hybrid Working 
We believe in the value of in-person collaboration while also supporting flexibility. Our hybrid working model includes three days per week in the office and the option to work remotely up to two days per week, unless role-specific requirements or business needs require you to be on site.

Equal Opportunity & Inclusion

Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech 

Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you.

Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering org, so this is a high-ownership seat: you'll take on large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives and drive them from first analysis through to completion, with real autonomy over how you get there. 

We don't run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a big topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn't the role; if you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you'll fit right in.

- Architecting and developing scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems. 

- Self-identifying and scoping problems and initiatives, not just executing assigned tickets: assessing impact, prioritisation and timing independently.

- Proactively spotting where AI and automation can drive technical improvement.

- Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database (we already scale reads horizontally). 

- Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery. 

- Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform, including the ability to recreate an Apaleo environment from scratch. 

- Extracting and reworking common services (like shared schedulers) to get us ready for our next scale level. 

What you'll bring to the team 

- 8+ years of backend development experience, including several years in a staff-level or technical leadership role. 

- Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms: we care more about how you think than which stack you've used.

- Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests: we don't have a dedicated QA function. 

- Fluent English. 

Nice to have 

- Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS/Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong. 

- Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other IaC approaches (like CloudFormation). 

- Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus experience is a good transferable equivalent). 

- Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Amazon CodeWhisperer) and a genuine interest in AI-driven engineering improvement. 

- Excellent collaboration and communication skills, particularly for introducing new technology, like AI tooling, to other teams. 

What we offer

- A diverse and international team: work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities. 

- Growth and development: 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and an evolving career framework. 

- Autonomy and ownership: we empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly in an environment built on trust and transparency.

- Flexible and remote work options: office, home or hybrid, based on what works for your role and team.

- An EGYM Wellpass membership giving access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options. 

Where you'll work from

title: Senior CRM & Lifecycle Analyst (B2C) – Marketing Automation (all genders)
description:
Du gestaltest CRM & Lifecycle Marketing bei Foodji von Grund auf mit – von der Segmentierung über automatisierte Journeys bis zur datenbasierten Optimierung.

Du verbindest strategisches Denken, analytische Tiefe und operative Umsetzung: Du entwickelst Hypothesen, übersetzt sie in intelligente Segmente und automatisierte Journeys, analysierst die Ergebnisse und leitest daraus die nächsten Maßnahmen ab. Dabei hast du die Zusammenhänge und Abläufe der relevanten Systeme und Datenquellen im Blick. 

Foodji ist dabei kein klassischer Onlineshop: Jeder Foodji hat individuelle Stocklevels und Produktkombinationen. Genau das macht CRM bei uns besonders spannend. Du entwickelst dynamische, hochgradig segmentierte Kampagnen und nutzt Daten, um die Kommunikation kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. 

Deine Mission bei Foodji: 

- Aufbau einer skalierbaren CRM- und Lifecycle-Funktion im B2C-Bereich sowie Übernahme der strategischen und operativen Verantwortung . 

- Verantwortung für den vollständigen Kampagnen-Lifecycle: von Hypothese und Konzeption über Segmentierung, A/B-Tests und Kohorten bis zum Aufbau, zur Analyse und zur Iteration automatisierter Flows. 

- Entwicklung dynamischer Segmente und Journeys, die unterschiedliche Stocklevels, Produktkombinationen und Nutzerbedürfnisse berücksichtigen. 

- Eigenständige Analyse von Daten, Identifikation relevanter Hebel und Priorisierung von Maßnahmen nach ihrem erwarteten Impact. 

- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product, Tech und Analytics, um Daten und technische Möglichkeiten für relevante CRM-Maßnahmen zu nutzen. 

- Verständnis der Zusammenhänge zwischen CRM-Systemen, Datenquellen und technischen Abläufen sowie Mitgestaltung der CRM-Systemlandschaft. 

- Mitgestaltung der CRM-Systemlandschaft sowie sichere Anwendung von Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder vergleichbaren Marketing-Automation-Plattformen als Core User. 

- Hands-on-Umsetzung von Maßnahmen – von der Konzeption und dem Flow-Aufbau bis zur Auswertung und Optimierung. 

DAS BRINGST DU MIT 

- Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in CRM, Lifecycle Marketing, Marketing Automation oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich. 

- Praktische Erfahrung mit dem vollständigen Kampagnen-Lifecycle – von Hypothese und Konzeption über komplexe Segmentierung, Kohorten und Flow-Aufbau bis zu Analyse und Iteration. 

- Starke analytische Arbeitsweise und ausgeprägte Daten-Affinität sowie Erfahrung mit A/B-Tests, Kohortenanalysen oder vergleichbaren Experimenten. 

- Erfahrung mit komplexen Segmenten und automatisierten Journeys in einem datengetriebenen CRM- oder Lifecycle-Umfeld. 

- Sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse in Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder einer vergleichbaren CRM- beziehungsweise Marketing-Automation-Plattform. 

- Technisches Grundverständnis für die Zusammenhänge und Abläufe von CRM-Systemen, Marketing-Automation-Plattformen und relevanten Datenquellen. 

- Strategische und operative Arbeitsweise: Du identifizierst Hebel, setzt Prioritäten und setzt Maßnahmen selbstständig um. 

- Sichere Kommunikation auf Deutsch oder Englisch in Wort und Schrift. 

Noch Fragen? 

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter! 

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR 

- Office Foodji: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office 

- bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente 

- Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung 

- EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios 

- JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec 

- KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind 

- Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands 

- Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen 

- Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Perspektiven! 

- Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland 

- Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür 

- Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam! 

ÜBER UNS 

Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds.

Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst. 

Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür. 

Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns.

Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt.

Sunday focuses on the psychology of care, companionship, and empathy. We build accessible worlds where players don't just solve puzzles, they rescue friends. By combining mass-market accessibility with deep emotional hooks, we are defining the next era of digital entertainment.

As Engineering Manager, you will lead Sunday's engineering team of approximately ten engineers across Unity game development and SDK. The position reports to the Director of Operations and works in close partnership with Production, Product, and Growth.

The role combines people leadership with technical ownership. Your primary responsibility is to lead and develop the team and to define how engineering operates. At the same time, you remain close enough to the code to own architectural decisions, review critical work and contribute directly where this supports delivery.

Our team delivers frequent releases across a portfolio of live games. We are looking for a leader who understands the trade-offs between quality, time and budget in the context of business priorities, and who translates them into sound technical decisions and the management of the team. This includes making our delivery pace sustainable through stable releases, a well-maintained codebase and engineering practices that scale with the business. The role carries a clear mandate to shape how engineering works at Sunday.

What you will own 

- People leadership: development plans, performance conversations against clear role expectations, hiring and onboarding. You hold conversations early and directly.

- Engineering ways of working: code review standards, quality gates before release, build and release pipeline, and a deliberate plan to reduce hotfixes and technical debt.

- Architecture and platform: owning the technical foundations shared across our games, including our in house SDK, analytics tracking, live configuration and the setup of A/B tests.

- Delivery partnership: working with the producers who lead our cross functional game teams on estimates, capacity and technical risk, and having the final say on whether a release is technically ready to ship.

- Transparency: making engineering progress, quality and capacity visible to the rest of the company through clear, measurable indicators.

What you bring 

- At least four years managing an engineering team of five or more people, including performance management and hiring.

- A strong engineering background of your own, ideally in C#, Unity or mobile development, so you can lead architecture and review decisions with credibility.

- A proven track record of success in a commercially driven company operating live products with real users, where engineering decisions are made against business priorities.

- A track record of raising quality and delivery predictability in a small or fast moving company, with concrete examples of what you changed and how you measured it.

- Comfort with direct conversations and with holding people to clear standards: Open, respectful, goal orientated.

- A pragmatic, data driven approach: you decide based on what the numbers show, and you introduce the process only where it pays back.

Strong plus 

- Experience in frequent shipping of mobile games, ideally free to play, casual or hybrid casual titles.

- Hands on knowledge of ad monetisation and mediation SDKs, mobile measurement partners and A/B testing infrastructure.

- Experience introducing CI/CD, automated testing or release quality gates in a game studio.

Fuel for the Journey: Benefits to Support Your Ambitions

- Invest in Your Future : Regular feedback and our development program support your growth, helping you expand your skill set and achieve your career goals.

- Easy Arrival to Sunday : From signing to settling in Hamburg, we’ve got you covered. Need a visa? No problem. Ready to build your new life and career at applike in Hamburg? We support every ambition - from learning German to a relocation bonus that helps you settle in and make Hamburg feel like home.

- Live Your Best Life, at Work and Beyond : We work in a hybrid setup with 3 core office days, plus flexible working hours. Enjoy 30 vacation days, 3 weeks of remote work per year, and free access to an in-house gym with lots of different fitness classes and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

- Thrive Where You Work : Enjoy the Alster Lake view from our central office with top-notch equipment, fun open spaces, and a large variety of snacks and drinks.

- Join the Community! Participate in regular team and company events, including hackathons and social gatherings. We work together, and we celebrate together, too.

If you want to build the future of digital companionship, Sunday is your home. Apply now!

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (all genders)
description:
Sunday Natural is one of Germany’s fastest-growing natural health brands, and our eCommerce platform is growing with it – today it serves 7 million monthly active users , runs on €400k of AWS per year , and supports a development organization of 30+ engineers . Every one of those numbers has moved sharply upward in the last few years, and all of them will keep moving.

You would be our first dedicated in-house Senior DevOps Engineer – and the two biggest engineering projects of the next two years are yours to help define and drive: bringing our entire infrastructure under Terraform, and strengthening the scalability, security and compliance posture across our cloud environments.

Your role 

- You shape the infrastructure vision. How we run, deploy, monitor and scale is yours to define, propose and defend.

- You work alongside our two external partners as the in-house technical counterpart – building the architecture and standards together, and bringing the deep platform knowledge back into the company. As the platform grows, taking the technical direction of that group is a natural next step, and one we would actively support.

- You own our AWS spend – €400k a year that currently has no dedicated owner, including where it goes and how we bring it down.

- You are the escalation point. When production is at risk, you decide.

- You report directly to the Head of eCommerce Platforms , with direct access to leadership for the decisions that need it.

What you'll own 

- AWS infrastructure – EC2, RDS, Fargate, CloudFront, S3, IAM – plus Cloudflare, DNS and WAF

- Security & compliance – DevSecOps practices, system audits, patching and access reviews, and GDPR-compliant data handling across every environment

- Infrastructure as code – taking us from manually managed to fully Terraform-defined

- Data layer – MySQL under production load: tuning, replication, and backups you have actually restored from

- Cloud economics – a €350k annual AWS budget with real headroom for optimisation

- Delivery for 30+ developers – Bitbucket Pipelines, environments, and how fast and safely code reaches production

- Reliability at 7M MAU – monitoring, logging, alerting and incident response (New Relic, Sentry, CloudWatch, PagerDuty)

Your profile 

- 7+ years running production infrastructure , with deep hands-on AWS as the person accountable when it breaks

- Security-conscious infrastructure operations – DevSecOps practices, system audits and access reviews, comfortable being accountable for GDPR-relevant data handling

- Infrastructure as code at scale – Terraform as your default way of working, on an estate of comparable size

- Deep Linux (Debian/Ubuntu) – you can trace a slow system from the kernel up and explain what you found

- MySQL under real load – slow-query analysis, replication, indexing, tested recovery

- Ownership of monitoring and incident response at scale – you have built the alerting that catches problems before customers report them, using tooling like New Relic, Datatog, etc. and run the on-call and post-incident process around it

- Experience defining standards that other engineers work to , whether with in-house teams or external partners, and holding the line on them

Nice to have 

- PHP-FPM / Magento 2 performance tuning, or Varnish and Redis at scale

- Cloud cost optimisation at six-figure annual spend

- AWS architecture certification

- Experience with SIEM tooling (e.g. Wazuh) or similar security monitoring

- Background in direct-to-consumer eCommerce or other high-traffic system operations

Our stack

Magento 2 · PIM · PHP · MySQL · Redis · Varnish · Docker · AWS · Terraform · Bitbucket Pipelines · New Relic · Sentry · CloudWatch · PagerDuty · Cloudflare

What we offer 

- An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins & nutrients

- We offer 28 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year

- The Urban Sports Club membership and either Swapfiets bike rental or a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket

- We believe great things happen when we meet in person, which is why we embrace a hybrid model with one home office day per week – up to two depending on the area you are working in – and up to two weeks per year working from abroad

- Receive various discounts of up to more than 50 percent on attractive brands such as Flaconi, Bosch, Apple or Expedia

- You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas

- We like to celebrate each other! Regular tea & office parties, Christmas and summer feasts and various influencer events such as Women's Day

We are looking forward to your application!

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations. 

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 400 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

We highly value equality of opportunity and inclusivity, and we would like to particularly encourage women and candidates from under-represented backgrounds to apply, even if you don’t match with 100% of the requirements.

- Triage compliance alerts and fix the root cause

Raise the bar

About You 

- You have a high appetite for Technology and AI and a natural curiosity for how it can transform your work. You’re comfortable using AI tools to automate repetitive 'busy work,' freeing you up to focus on high-impact work.

- Solid mid-level or senior experience building and shipping full-stack software in a SaaS product company

- Deep backend experience in C# and .NET, and enough Angular or TypeScript to work across the stack

- Deep knowledge of cloud patterns, application and database performance, with experience applying them to varying workflows and workloads

- You’ve built integrations with third-party systems where the details matter: payments, tax, invoicing, compliance or similar

- You can take a vague requirement, like a new country’s tax rules, and turn it into something shipped

- You do your best work async: you write things down clearly, unblock yourself and don’t need constant check-ins

Bonus points for experience with European fiscal rules, or for speaking French or German. You don’t need to match every point.

We believe AI is a career-defining inflection point. ROLLER is a fast adopter of new technology like AI, and every team member is empowered to own their learning and use the latest tools to supercharge their impact. We’re looking for candidates with the proficiency and curiosity to embrace AI and technology, not just as a technical skill, but as a core competency to help us achieve big goals. Our engineers use Claude and other AI coding tools day to day.

🍼 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for primary carers and 4 weeks paid Parental Leave for secondary carers

You are part Field CTO, part Industry Strategist, part Technical Specialist, and part Partner Relations Lead. You will be the technical authority within our EMEA partner ecosystem: setting the vision for how Coder fits into each partner’s AI, cloud, and modernization offerings, co-creating the GTM sales plays that partner sellers take to market, building the demonstrations and workshops that generate pipeline, and producing the Partner Relations content that establishes Coder’s technical brand in the ecosystem.

This is not a support role. You are equally comfortable holding a strategic roadmap conversation with a partner CTO and debugging a Kubernetes deployment in a partner’s lab in the same afternoon. You are energized by the challenge of building a new category through partnerships, motivated by the multiplied impact of enabling an entire ecosystem rather than a single customer, and capable of operating with full autonomy in a fast-moving startup environment.

What You’ll Do 

- Serve as the strategic technical thought partner to EMEA partner leadership, including practice leads, CTOs, and solutions architects at global systems integrators, regional cloud consultancies, and hyperscaler field teams. Own the technical relationship and set the vision for how Coder fits into each partner’s AI and modernization portfolio.

- Co-create sales plays tailored to each partner’s customer base, vertical focus, and services capabilities. Author Working Backwards outcome proposals for strategic partner-customer combinations that translate AI Development Infrastructure into deal-level urgency.

- Codify each successful partner engagement into a repeatable GTM play: trigger conditions, discovery questions, positioning framework, demo script, PoV scope template, and expected outcomes. Build a playbook library that a new PDE or partner seller can pick up and run.

- Build AI-powered self-service tools that automate high-volume PDE activities: Opportunity Brief Generator, PR/FAQ Generator, Workshop-in-a-Box deployment, and demo site builder.

- Produce a monthly partner intelligence digest from EMEA engagements: what customers are asking for, how competitors are positioning, where integrations are missing, which vertical use cases are emerging. Distribute to Product, Engineering, and GTM leadership.

- Own the EMEA-relevant portions of the joint technical integration roadmap with strategic partners. Define priorities cross-functionally with Product and Engineering based on field signals from the EMEA market.

- Create and publish Partner Relations content, the ecosystem equivalent of Developer Relations: technical blog posts, cookbooks, partner ecosystem conference talks, enablement videos, and workshop recaps. Build Coder’s technical brand within the EMEA partner community.

What We’re Looking For 

- 7+ years of experience in a combination of Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Field CTO, Technical Consulting, or Developer Relations roles at an infrastructure, developer tools, or AI company

- Demonstrated experience helping partners or customers understand and adopt products in emerging or undefined categories, not just executing playbooks for established ones

- Proven hands-on experience designing and deploying cloud infrastructure on at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure), with production-level Kubernetes and Terraform depth. You have done the work and can speak to it with specificity.

- 2+ years deploying or operating AI coding agents in a production or near-production environment: you understand how agent loops execute, where credentials live, and what governance and audit requirements look like in a European enterprise context

- Ability to articulate the architectural difference between workspace-local agent tooling and a centralized agentic harness, and to explain why that distinction matters to a security, compliance, or data sovereignty stakeholder

- Experience working with channel or technology partners in a co-sell model: hyperscaler partner programs, GSI/RSI partnerships, or VAR/distributor ecosystems in EMEA markets

- Experience building repeatable technical GTM assets that scaled beyond your personal delivery: sales plays, enablement curricula, reference architectures, or technical content programs

- Executive communication and Field CTO credibility: you can hold a technical vision conversation with a partner CTO and a deal-level architecture review with an SE in the same day, in English and ideally at least one additional European language

- Strong written communication: you can produce a Working Backwards PR/FAQ, a technical architecture document, and a blog post without those being separate skills requiring separate people

- Self-directed, analytically minded, and comfortable operating with full autonomy. You will define processes that don’t exist, build tools that haven’t been scoped, and create a function from first principles in a new region.

Bonus Points 

(Bonus tacos? That’s how we say thanks at Coder. Ask us about it.) 

- Prior Forward Deployed Engineer experience at a platform company (Palantir, Scale AI, frontier AI lab, or equivalent embedded deployment model)

- Track record of public technical advocacy: blog posts, conference talks, open-source contributions, or developer/partner community engagement

- Experience with hyperscaler partner programs (e.g., ISV Accelerate, strategic collaboration agreements, co-sell programs) at an operational level

- Familiarity with European regulatory environments: GDPR, DORA, NIS2, AI Act compliance requirements, and data sovereignty patterns for cloud-native deployments

- Experience with air-gapped or network-isolated deployments common in European financial services, government, or defense contexts

- Background in AI governance frameworks, session audit requirements, or SIEM integration for AI workloads

- Experience with LLM gateway or proxy infrastructure (LiteLLM, OpenRouter, or equivalent) in a multi-team or enterprise context

- Experience designing human-in-the-loop breakpoints or escalation patterns for autonomous agent workflows

- Kubernetes certification (CKA, CKAD, or CKS)

- Experience with Tailscale or similar overlay networking tools

- Open-source contributions, particularly in CNCF, MCP, or AI agent ecosystems

- Existing relationships with hyperscaler EMEA solutions architecture teams, European GSI technical practices, or AI infrastructure partner ecosystems

- Fluency in German, French, or a Nordic language in addition to English

Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. The Senior Technical Support Engineer is a technical escalation point for complex, high-impact, and sensitive customer issues. This is a senior individual contributor role with technical leadership responsibilities and no direct reports. This position reports directly to the Manager, Customer Success and receives functional direction from the Director, Technical Support. 

What You’ll Do 

- Own resolution of escalated, high-severity, or cross-system customer issues, providing clear and timely customer communication while balancing speed, technical quality, and customer impact. 

- Lead root-cause and trend analysis for complex or recurring issues, quantify customer and support impact, and partner with Engineering to implement and validate corrective actions that reduce repeat cases. 

- Provide senior technical leadership during customer-impacting incidents and contribute to post-incident reviews, including timelines, root-cause findings, corrective actions, and recommendations. 

- Provide technical guidance and coaching to Technical Support Engineers during complex investigations, escalations, and incident response. 

- Represent customer impact in defect triage and product feedback forums by providing clear evidence, use cases, severity context, and recommended priorities. 

- Define and improve support playbooks, escalation paths, and diagnostic standards. 

- Create and maintain reusable technical guidance, diagnostic procedures, and knowledge articles, and apply that content to new-hire onboarding and ongoing team development. 

What We’re Looking For 

- Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 

- 5+ years of experience investigating complex technical issues in enterprise software support, systems engineering, digital forensics, or a related technical environment. 

- Demonstrated ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including customers experiencing high-impact or sensitive issues. 

- Strong incident management, root cause analysis, and cross-functional leadership skills. 

- Demonstrated experience coaching technical support professionals and developing or improving diagnostic practices, escalation standards, or support procedures. 

What Success Looks Like 

- High-impact and sensitive customer issues are resolved in a timely manner, with clear communication and strong technical quality. 

- Recurring issues are identified and addressed through validated corrective actions, reducing repeat cases and customer impact. 

- Technical Support Engineers apply stronger diagnostic practices, escalation standards, and technical guidance during complex investigations. 

- Customer impact is translated into actionable product feedback that contributes to improved product quality and support effectiveness. 

Preferred Qualifications 

- Advanced experience with Magnet Forensics products or comparable digital forensics platforms. Successful candidates may be required to complete relevant Magnet certifications after hire. 

- Professional fluency in written and spoken Arabic to support Arabic-speaking customers. 

- Industry-recognized AI, Cloud, or networking certifications and introductory programming experience. 

- Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Knowledge. 

Working Conditions 

- This role follows a Sunday-to-Thursday work week, with standard working hours of 9 am to 5 pm Arabia Standard Time. Corresponding UK working hours vary between GMT and BST due to seasonal clock changes. 

- This is a remote role based in the United Kingdom. 

- The position involves extended periods of computer-based work. 

- Occasional work outside standard hours may be required to address critical customer issues. 

- Occasional travel may be required for customer engagements, training, or team meetings.

The Compensation range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. Please note that the actual compensation may vary depending on location and job-related factors such as qualifications, experience, knowledge and skills. If you are applying for this role outside of the primary location and you are selected for an interview, the Talent Acquisition Partner can share more information with you.   

Position Type: New Position 

Magnet is proud to offer benefits such as: 

- Generous time off policies 

- Competitive compensation 

- Volunteer opportunities 

- Reward and recognition programs 

- Employee committees & resource groups 

- Healthcare and retirement benefits

We’re looking for someone who checks off most, but not all, of the boxes listed in “skills and experiences”. It’s more important to us to find candidates who can display indicators of success through skills they have developed and experiences they have been a part of, than to find folks who have “been there, done that”. We want to be part of your development journey, and we’ll learn as much from you as you learn from us. 

How We Work 

At Magnet Forensics, we take a hybrid-flexible approach to support your productivity and work-life balance. If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. These in-person moments help us build stronger connections, spark new ideas, and celebrate our successes together. Most days, you can choose what works best for you, while staying in tune with your team’s goals. 

We’re excited to welcome you to our team and look forward to achieving great things together - both in the office and wherever you work best!

We’re looking for candidates that can provide examples of how they have demonstrated Magnet CODE in their previous experiences: 

CARE – We care about each other and our mission to make a difference in the world. 

OWN – We are accountable for our results – while never forgetting to act with integrity, empathy, and respect.

This commitment will be reflected in our hiring processes and embedded in our values and how we treat one another. If you’re interested in this role, but do not meet all of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply anyways.
