title: Senior Embedded Performance Engineer
description:
Auterion builds a cutting-edge operating system for autonomous robotic systems that empower a diverse range of platforms to perform surveillance, reconnaissance, inspection, mapping and logistics tasks. Our industry-leading software drives the adoption of robotic fleets and is recognized by the U.S. government as the future standard for its drone programs. 

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Performance Engineer who is passionate about getting the most out of embedded systems — from low-level Linux tuning and hardware integration to high-performance video and data pipelines. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to hardware, moving across the stack, and solving the kinds of problems where milliseconds, bandwidth, startup time, and system efficiency matter.

You will work across the AuterionOS ecosystem on topics such as:

- Embedded Linux performance and system tuning

- Low-latency video streaming and media pipelines

- C/C++, Python, and Bash-based platform development

- Hardware integration, system profiling, and end-to-end optimization

- Collaboration with experienced and driven engineers across Auterion

Responsibilities 

- Work within the Apps & Simulation team and collaborate with other development teams to build high-performance products for autonomous systems.

- Design, optimize, and maintain performance-critical components within AuterionOS, Auterion’s custom embedded Linux distribution.

- Improve end-to-end system behavior across compute, networking, video, and hardware interfaces, with a strong focus on latency, throughput, reliability, and resource efficiency.

- Analyze and optimize demanding workloads such as real-time telemetry, video streaming, media processing, and communication between distributed system components.

- Investigate system bottlenecks across the full stack, from kernel and OS behavior to application-level code and tooling.

- Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand both internal and customer use cases, and translate them into robust technical solutions.

- Propose and implement new platform capabilities with a strong emphasis on measurable performance gains in real-world deployments.

- Participate in daily stand-ups, release planning, and prioritization discussions.

Qualifications and Skills 

- B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

- 5+ years of professional experience writing object-oriented C++ and/or Python.

- Deep experience with embedded Linux systems, including cross-compilation, debugging, profiling, and performance tuning.

- Strong hands-on background in diagnosing and optimizing real-world system behavior, including CPU, memory, I/O, networking, boot time, and application latency.

- Experience building or optimizing low-latency video or data-streaming pipelines, ideally on embedded platforms.

- Excellent understanding of software systems that span embedded devices, higher-level applications, and fully integrated products.

- Strong software engineering fundamentals, including system design, implementation, debugging, and testing.

- Experience with video codecs, GStreamer, RTP/RTSP, or hardware-accelerated media pipelines.

- Solid experience with Debian/Ubuntu-based systems, Bash scripting, and systemd.

- Experience with Docker and docker-compose in complex development and deployment environments, as well as qemu.

- Strong debugging and performance analysis skills at both system and application level, combined with a proactive and self-directed working style.

- Proficient in ROS2/DDS-style middleware and experienced with networking across multiple OSI layers, including REST APIs and performance-sensitive communication paths.

- Experience with system integration and interfacing sensors or peripherals, especially via USB and Ethernet.

- Experience working in an agile engineering environment with stand-ups, sprint planning, and shared ownership across teams.

- Bonus: Experience with build systems such as CMake, including improving build performance in large-scale software projects.

Benefits 

- Flexible working hours

- Stock Options

- Generous holiday allowance

- Company pension plan 

- Car parking 

- Enhanced maternity & paternity leave

- Mental health and wellbeing support

- Learning and development opportunities

About Auterion 

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

title: Production Planner
description:
At Harvey Performance Company, we're more than a team; we're a community. Our thriving, dynamic, and rapidly expanding organization values community, celebrates success, and fosters personal and professional growth opportunities.

Taken

The opportunity 
Harvey Performance Company manufactures consumable precision cutting tools for industrial customers. We are seeking an experienced Production Planner to own production scheduling and material planning across our manufacturing operations.

This role is responsible for translating demand forecasts and customer orders into achievable production schedules, ensuring material and capacity availability through disciplined use of SAP/Epicor ERP and Material Requirements Planning (MRP), and driving on-time delivery in a fast-paced, high-volume parts production environment

In this role, you will be responsible for 

- Develop, publish, and maintain detailed production schedules across manufacturing cells/lines to meet customer demand, on-time delivery targets, and inventory objectives.

- Own and execute Material Requirements Planning (MRP) within SAP/Epicor ERP, reviewing planned orders, exception messages, and net requirements to ensure timely material availability.

- Maintain accuracy of SAP planning master data, including planning parameters, lead times, lot sizes, safety stock levels, BOMs, routings, etc.

- Balance production capacity against demand forecasts and customer orders, adjusting schedules for a high-volume, high-mix precision manufacturing environment.

- Partner with Purchasing/Supply Chain to resolve material shortages, expedite critical components, and manage supplier lead times.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering and Customer Service/Sales to resolve scheduling conflicts and support new product introductions.

- Monitor work-in-process (WIP), backlog, and finished goods inventory; identify and drive inventory optimization opportunities.

- Participate in and support the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process, providing planning input and capacity analysis.

- Track and report key planning KPIs (on-time delivery, schedule adherence, machine/labor utilization, inventory turns) to operations leadership.

- Identify, recommend, and implement continuous improvement initiatives to planning processes, systems, and data integrity (Lean/Six Sigma principles).

- Support daily production meetings and escalating schedule risks proactively.

Vereisten

You’ll bring: 

- Minimum 5 years of production planning/scheduling experience in a high-volume parts manufacturing environment (required).

- Demonstrated hands-on experience with SAP ERP (PP and MM modules) and Epicor for production planning and material management (required).

- Highly competent in Material Requirements Planning (MRP) concepts, execution, and troubleshooting (required).

- Experience in precision manufacturing, cutting tools, metalworking, or a related consumable parts industry is strongly preferred.

- Strong analytical and Excel/data analysis skills; comfortable working with large datasets and planning reports.

- Excellent communication, organizational, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

- Proven ability to manage competing priorities and make sound decisions in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

- Qualification in supply chain management, Business, Industrial Engineering and advantage or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

- Advanced knowledge of MRP logic, demand planning, and capacity planning principles.

- Strong problem-solving skills with a data-driven, root-cause approach.

- Ability to read and interpret BOMs, routings, and production schedules.

- Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies.

- High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

Benefits

What Harvey provides: 
Do you want to get the very best out of yourself? So do we! That’s why, in addition to great colleagues and a cutting-edge high-tech environment, we offer

- a competitive, market-based salary of €55.000,- to €65.000,-

- a high degree of independence, responsibility, and opportunities to learn

- an in-house fitness center

- 26 vacation days

- several fun company outings and parties each year

- Occasional travel to other group/ divisional manufacturing sites

title: HR Operations Specialist
description:
Bij Quaker Houghton zijn we experts in de ontwikkeling, productie en toepassing van industriële procesvloeistoffen, smeermiddelen en coatings voor de maakindustrie. Wij spelen al jarenlang een belangrijke rol in de groei van ’s werelds grootste industriële en productiebedrijven, van de luchtvaart- en automobielsector tot de metaal- en energiesector. Vandaag de dag zijn wij wereldwijd actief, met ons hoofdkantoor gevestigd in Conshohocken, Pennsylvania (VS).

Quaker Houghton is een wereldwijd beursgenoteerd bedrijf met een unieke, samenwerkingsgerichte cultuur die de professionele groei van medewerkers stimuleert en aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden en secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden biedt.

Over de functie 

Wij zijn op zoek naar een HR Operations Specialist ter versterking van ons Global HR Operations-team. In deze functie ben je het eerste aanspreekpunt voor medewerkers in Nederland en zorg je voor een soepele en positieve medewerkerervaring gedurende de gehele employee lifecycle.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het beheren van HR-processen, het onderhouden van personeelsdossiers, het ondersteunen van compliance-activiteiten en het samenwerken met collega's binnen HR, Talent Acquisition, Payroll en de business. Daarnaast krijg je de kans om bij te dragen aan regionale HR-initiatieven en projecten die operationele excellentie en continue verbetering binnen de EMEA-regio stimuleren.

Dit is een uitstekende kans voor een HR-professional die graag werkt in een dynamische, internationale omgeving en passie heeft voor het leveren van hoogwaardige HR-dienstverlening en ondersteuning aan medewerkers.

Tasks

Wat ga je doen? 

Beheer van de Employee Lifecycle

- Beheren van HR-administratie en HR-processen gedurende de gehele employee lifecycle, van onboarding tot offboarding.

- Opstellen en uitgeven van arbeidsovereenkomsten, contractwijzigingen en andere HR-gerelateerde documentatie.

- Bijhouden van nauwkeurige personeelsgegevens en waarborgen van de datakwaliteit binnen HR-systemen.

- Ondersteunen van organisatorische wijzigingen, waaronder promoties, overplaatsingen en andere personeelsmutaties.

Ondersteuning van medewerkers en leidinggevenden

- Fungeren als eerste aanspreekpunt voor HR-gerelateerde vragen.

- Tijdige, nauwkeurige en servicegerichte ondersteuning bieden aan medewerkers en leidinggevenden.

- Complexe vraagstukken waar nodig escaleren of coördineren met de juiste HR-teams.

Onboarding en Offboarding

- Coördineren van onboardingactiviteiten voor nieuwe medewerkers om een soepele start te waarborgen.

- Samenwerken met interne stakeholders om onboardingvereisten te faciliteren.

- Beheren van offboardingactiviteiten en medewerkers begeleiden gedurende het uitdiensttredingsproces.

Compliance en HR-administratie

- Ervoor zorgen dat personeelsgegevens en HR-processen voldoen aan lokale wet- en regelgeving en bedrijfsbeleid.

- Ondersteunen bij de administratie van lokale arbeidsvoorwaarden en HR-programma's.

- Assisteren bij disciplinaire trajecten, employee relations-zaken en compliance-gerelateerde activiteiten onder begeleiding van HR Business Partners.

HR-systemen en Continue Verbetering

- Onderhouden en actualiseren van personeelsgegevens in HR-systemen.

- Uitvoeren van periodieke data-audits om nauwkeurigheid en consistentie te waarborgen.

- Ondersteunen van HR-projecten en procesverbeteringsinitiatieven gericht op het verhogen van operationele efficiëntie en het verbeteren van de medewerkerervaring.

Requirements

Wat breng je mee? 

Opleiding

- Bacheloropleiding in Human Resources, Psychologie, Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied.

- Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring in een functie binnen HR Operations, HR-administratie of People Operations.

Ervaring

- Gedegen kennis van Nederlandse arbeidswetgeving en HR-administratieve vereisten.

- Ervaring met het ondersteunen van HR-processen gedurende de gehele employee lifecycle.

- Ervaring met HRIS/HCM-systemen; ervaring met Workday is een sterke pré.

- Ervaring binnen een internationale of multinationale werkomgeving is een pluspunt.

- Een HR-certificering wordt beschouwd als een pré.

Vaardigheden

- Sterke organisatorische vaardigheden en het vermogen om effectief meerdere prioriteiten tegelijkertijd te beheren.

- Grote nauwkeurigheid en oog voor detail.

- Klantgerichte instelling met een passie voor excellente ondersteuning van medewerkers.

- Sterke analytische vaardigheden en probleemoplossend vermogen.

- Vermogen om zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband te werken.

- Flexibel en comfortabel in een veranderende omgeving, met oog voor procesverbeteringen.

- Goede beheersing van Microsoft Office-applicaties, met name Outlook, Excel en PowerPoint.

Talen

- Vloeiend Nederlands en Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

Benefits

Wat bieden wij? 

- Hybride werkmodel (3 dagen per week op kantoor in Uithoorn).

- Toegang tot QH University (meer dan 500 leerprogramma's) en uitgebreide ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden.

- Vergoeding voor zorgverzekering.

- Pensioenregeling.

- Regeling voor het kopen en verkopen van vakantiedagen.

- Exposure aan regionale HR-processen en samenwerking met diverse functies binnen EMEA.

- Een collegiale en internationale HR-werkomgeving.

- Well-being programma's, Colleague Resource Groups en andere aantrekkelijke DEI-initiatieven.

- Global Giving-initiatieven met betaald vrijwilligersverlof voor een maatschappelijk doel naar keuze.

Deze functie biedt een uitstekende mogelijkheid om je carrière binnen HR Operations verder te ontwikkelen en tegelijkertijd een waardevolle bijdrage te leveren aan medewerkers en de organisatie.

Wie zijn wij? 

Wij zijn wereldwijd marktleider op het gebied van industriële processen en werktuigbouwkundige oplossingen, actief in meer dan 40 landen. We blijven voortdurend verbeteren en innoveren zodat industriële producenten wereldwijd succesvol kunnen blijven in een snel veranderende wereld.

Vanuit meer dan 100 locaties werken onze engineers, chemici en industrie-experts nauw samen met klanten om hen te helpen nóg efficiënter en effectiever te opereren, wat de toekomst ook brengt.

Onze waarden

- Live Safe 

- Exceed Customer Expectations 

- Drive Results 

- Embrace Diversity 

- Do Great Things Together 

Onze kernwaarden vormen de basis van wie wij zijn als organisatie. Ze sturen onze beslissingen, inspireren ons dagelijks en dragen bij aan een veiligere en sterkere Quaker Houghton. Deze waarden vormen de leidraad voor zowel ons interne handelen als onze relaties met klanten, partners en de maatschappij.

EEO: Quaker Houghton zet zich in voor gelijke kansen op de arbeidsmarkt en een werkomgeving vrij van discriminatie. Sollicitaties zijn welkom van alle gekwalificeerde kandidaten, ongeacht geslacht, genderidentiteit, leeftijd, beperking, etnische afkomst, religie of seksuele gerichtheid. In lijn met de Europese Richtlijn Loontransparantie wordt de salarisschaal voor deze functie voorafgaand aan het sollicitatiegesprek gedeeld om transparantie en consistentie binnen ons wervingsproces te ondersteunen. Kandidaten worden niet gevraagd naar hun salarisgeschiedenis. Onze organisatie werkt met een gestructureerd functieniveau- en salarishuis om objectieve en consistente beloningsbeslissingen te waarborgen.

title: Business Developer B2B & Retail
description:
Bij de meeste salesbanen stopt je werk bij de afspraak. Bij MarketLeap begint het daar pas.

Ik ben Luc, mede-oprichter van MarketLeap. Wij zijn het externe salesteam van online gepositioneerde merken met een fysiek product. Onze klanten verkopen o.a. stoomreinigers, elektrische scooters, spark machines, pilates-reformers, stoelviltdoppen en autopoetsmiddelen. Wij zorgen dat die producten bij grote retailketens, groothandels en distributeurs terechtkomen, zowel nationaal als internationaal. Niet met alleen een lijst aan leads of een ingeplande afspraak, maar met een getekende deal en een product in het schap.

Onze merken vind je terug bij de Makro, Coolblue, Albert Heijn, Decathlon, Praxis, Karwei, Bouwmaat, Welkoop, Intratuin, MediaMarkt, Intersport, Sport2000, en we zitten aan tafel met grote internationale distribiteurs. Dat zijn dus niet alleen logo's op onze site, dat zijn concrete deals die ons team heeft gerealiseerd. We bestaan sinds 2023, hebben ruim 140 klanttrajecten gedraaid en zijn winstgevend. We zoeken per direct versterking van één a twee business developers voor ons team van zes business developers en twee founders in Utrecht.

Taken

Je bent de business developer van vijf tot zes merken tegelijk. Voor elk merk maak je een projectplan met heldere targets, zoek je de juiste afnemers, vindt je de beslissers, belt, mailt, plant de afspraak, voert het gesprek, maakt het voorstel en onderhandelt tot de handtekening. Daarna blijf jij het aanspreekpunt, want de herhaalorders zijn waar het geld zit, voor de klant en voor jou.

Zo ziet dit er in de praktijk uit. Zelf heb ik voor een van ons klanten een stoomreiniger bij Makro in het assortiment geplaatst, en de tweede,derde en vierde bestelling volgde. Een collega bouwde bij Decathlon een relatie op waar de orders sindsdien blijven doorlopen. In de eerste 30 dagen zorgde dit al voor tienduizenden euro's extra omzet voor onze klant.

Elke week bel je zo'n 80 tot 100 keer, ongeveer twee uur per dag. De rest van je tijd gaat naar het uitdenken van de strategie, klant management, voeren van warme gesprekken, voorstellen uitwerken, op afspraak gaan en het bijhouden van je pijplijn. Elke maandag stuur je de ondernemer achter het merk je weekplan en elke vrijdag je evaluatie. Het repeterende werk, zoals leadlijsten bouwen, research op een keten en de eerste opzet van een pitchdeck, hebben we in Claude Cowork geautomatiseerd met eigen skills. Jij werkt met HubSpot, Aircall, Apollo, Lusha, Notion en Claude, zodat je tijd gaat naar het voeren van gesprekken en closen van deals.

Hoe je start: 

In je eerste maand krijg je één of twee eigen klanten. We doen niet aan een meeloopperiode van een kwartaal. Vanaf dag één heb je direct een klant waar jij verantwoordelijk voor bent. Zo leer je accountmanagement, sales en relatiebeheer op de enige manier die werkt, door het te doen. Je doet dat niet alleen. Week 1 zit je in het inwerkprogramma. Hierin neem je onze SOP's door, leer je de systemen kennen en kijk je mee bij een collega op een lopende deal. Daarna heb je een ervaren buddy die je eerste mails valideert en na je eerste gesprekken met je terugkijkt. Wekelijks krijg je salestraining en heb je een 1-op-1 met mij. Dagelijks kun je bij mij en de buddy terecht.

Vereisten

- 2 tot 5 jaar werkervaring in een commerciële rol. 

- Je hebt al deals geclosed en kunt dit aantonen. Je hebt ook geleerd waarom een deal niet doorging en wist dit vervolgens snel te implementeren. 

- Je woont binnen een uur van Utrecht en bent drie dagen per week op kantoor.

- Rijbewijs en een eigen auto zijn een must. Je gaat naar onze klanten en potentiële afnemers toe.

- Vloeiend Nederlands, in spraak en op papier.

- 40 uur per week beschikbaar, in loondienst. 

- Je neemt eigenaarschap over je pijplijn en je resultaten. Je krijgt energie van targets, deals en een product dat door jou uiteindelijk in het schap terug te vinden is.

Benefits

- Basissalaris 3.200 tot 3.700 euro per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring.

- De helft van de commissie die wij factureren over deals die jij sluit. Ook over elke herhaalorder, twee tot drie jaar lang. Geen plafond.

- Extra bonussen bij grote wins.

- Kilometervergoeding van €0,23,-per kilometer.

- 25 vakantiedagen

- Interne salestraining en dagelijks aan het werk met de nieuwste AI-tooling, ingericht voor dit werk.

- Een hecht team van zes business developers en twee founders, 28 lopende klant trajecten, winstgevend en groeiend.

- Hybride: drie dagen kantoor in Utrecht, twee dagen thuis.

- Regelmatige leuke teamuitjes en sportieve activiteiten zoals padel.

Herken je jezelf hierin? Stuur je CV en drie regels over een deal waar je het meest trots op bent. Binnen twee werkdagen hoor je van mij. Daarna plannen we een belafspraak in van 20 a 30 minuten, gevolgd door een gesprek op kantoor in Utrecht met mij en een van de business developers. Bij een match vanuit beide kanten ontvang je een concreet aanbod. Van sollicitatie tot handtekening duurt zo'n twee weken en eventueel sneller als het kan.

Luc Broos, mede-oprichter MarketLeap

title: Stagiair HR
company: Stichting De Meerpaal & De Meerpaal Beheer B.V.
description:
Meerpaal, centraal gelegen aan hét plein in hartje Dronten, is een unieke organisatie, met 130 medewerkers en vele betrokken vrijwilligers. Meerpaal bestaat onder andere uit een welzijnsorganisatie, theater (grote zaal en kleine zaal), bioscoop en een kunstencentrum. Wij geloven dat meedoen in de positieve zin bijdraagt aan mens en maatschappij! 

Meerpaal is op zoek naar een 

Stagiair HR 

Taken

Stage of afstuderen bij HR – Meerpaal 
Wil jij tijdens je stage niet alleen meekijken, maar meedenken, meedoen én impact maken ? Bij Meerpaal krijg je die ruimte. Als stagiair of afstudeerder bij HR draai je mee in een veelzijdige maatschappelijke en culturele organisatie. Je werkt mee aan actuele HR-vraagstukken, projecten en beleid en ontdekt hoe HR bijdraagt aan goed werkgeverschap, persoonlijk leiderschap, talentontwikkeling en verbinding.

Wat bieden wij jou? 
Je krijgt ruimte om je stage mede vorm te geven. Samen kijken we welke opdrachten passen bij jouw opleiding, talenten en onze organisatie. 

- Je werkt mee aan HR-projecten en de dagelijkse praktijk;

- Je maakt kennis met verschillende HR-processen, cao’s en organisatieonderdelen;

- Je krijgt begeleiding én ruimte om zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid te nemen;

- Je onderzoekt hoe HR kan bijdragen aan samenwerking, leiderschap en talentontwikkeling;

- Je krijgt de ruimte om te leren, initiatief te nemen en ook fouten te mogen maken en je ontvangt een stagevergoeding van € 450,00 per maand op basis van een fulltime dienstverband.*

Bij Meerpaal werken we vanuit drie kernwaarden. Die willen we ook in jouw stage terugzien:
Betrokken – je bent nieuwsgierig naar mensen, zoekt de samenwerking op en wilt begrijpen wat er in de organisatie speelt.
Betrouwbaar – je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, komt afspraken na en gaat zorgvuldig om met mensen en informatie.
Duidelijkheid – je stelt vragen, durft je mening te geven en communiceert open en helder.

Vereisten

Wie zoeken we? 
Je volgt een mbo- of hbo-opleiding in de richting van HR, psychologie, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare opleiding en zoekt een meewerkstage of afstudeertraject.
We zoeken vooral iemand die leergierig, energiek en nieuwsgierig is. Iemand die initiatief durft te nemen, graag samenwerkt met verschillende disciplines en wil ontdekken waar zijn of haar talent het beste tot zijn recht komt.

Wij verwachten niet dat je alles al kunt. We verwachten wel dat je wilt leren, onderzoeken en bijdragen. 
Kun je op korte termijn beginnen dan is dat mooi.
Zoek je een stageplek voor 2027 dan ontvangen wij ook graag jouw sollicitatie. 

Interesse? We ontvangen graag je motivatie en cv voor 15 oktober 2026.

title: Senior Data Analyst / Software Engineer
description:
Data, software & technische toepassingen 

FULLTIME · ROTTERDAM

Thermeleon ontwikkelt een innovatieve Warmtebatterij voor hightech kassen. Onze projecten leveren uiteenlopende klimaat-, energie-, sensor- en productdata op. Deze data vormt de basis voor betrouwbare analyses, klantinzichten en verdere verbetering van onze technologie. 

We zoeken een Senior Data Analyst / Software Engineer die sterke analytische vaardigheden combineert met praktische softwareontwikkeling. Je helpt een schaalbare data- en softwareomgeving op te bouwen: van data-inname en kwaliteitscontrole tot dashboards, analyseprocessen en technische tools. 

Je werkt niet op afstand van het fysieke product. Je werkt direct samen met engineers, onderzoekers en analisten aan toepassingen voor kas- en klantprojecten.

Taken

Data-infrastructuur en datakwaliteit 

Je ontwerpt en ontwikkelt betrouwbare datastromen voor sensoren, technische systemen en andere relevante databronnen. 

Je structureert de opslag, verwerking en beschikbaarheid van project- en tijdreeksdata. 

Je ontwikkelt methoden om data uit verschillende systemen en formaten goed samen te brengen. 

Je automatiseert controles, monitoring en foutafhandeling. 

Je stelt praktische standaarden op voor datakwaliteit, documentatie, traceerbaarheid en versiebeheer. 

Je zorgt dat data bruikbaar en beschikbaar is voor analyses, dashboards, technische evaluaties en productontwikkeling. 

Je houdt rekening met passende toegang en bescherming van klantdata en interne kennis. 

Data-analyse en technische inzichten 

Je ontwikkelt herbruikbare analyseprocessen voor klimaat-, energie- en productdata. 

Je analyseert tijdreeksen en helpt verschillen tussen situaties, perioden en projecten te verklaren. 

Je ondersteunt de ontwikkeling van betrouwbare vergelijkingen, baselines en prestatieberekeningen. 

Je vertaalt statistische en technische resultaten naar duidelijke inzichten voor engineers en andere collega’s. 

Je beoordeelt en verbetert analyses van de Data Analyst. 

Je werkt samen met Performance en R&D om technische methoden om te zetten in betrouwbare analyses. 

Je bepaalt welke analyses geautomatiseerd kunnen worden en waar inhoudelijke interpretatie nodig blijft. 

Software en technische tools 

Je bouwt software waarmee technische teams projecten sneller en consistenter kunnen analyseren. 

Je ontwikkelt praktische tools voor berekeningen, scenarioanalyses, projectevaluaties en technische besluitvorming. 

Je zet prototypes en onderzoeksresultaten om in betrouwbare, onderhoudbare software. 

Je integreert relevante interne en externe rekenmethoden in bruikbare toepassingen. 

Je ontwikkelt waar relevant koppelingen met externe systemen en platforms. 

Je werkt mee aan zowel de technische achterkant als gebruiksvriendelijke interfaces.

title: Cloud Security Engineer
description:
YGO.ai is a VC-funded AI tourism platform. We are hiring a Cloud Security Engineer to own the security of our cloud platform, the APIs our enterprise clients run on and the company itself.

🛡️ About this role. The role carries two things at once. You own security engineering directly and hands-on. You build the security function around it as we grow. At YGO a pod lead is a squad leader and a spokesperson, close to the work and close to the client, rather than a full-time manager. You will not stop being an engineer.

The work is broad. You might review source code in the morning, investigate an endpoint alert after lunch and help design a new authentication flow the next day. You identify the highest-risk problems, decide what happens first and execute.

We serve major travel enterprises and we have enterprise commitments going live from the start of 2027. Security is a condition of that business, not a layer added afterwards.

🧑‍💻 What you'll own

- Application security. Hands-on code and architecture review across our APIs, backend services and internal tooling. Targeted penetration testing to validate issues yourself. Working with engineers on root causes and practical fixes rather than handing over reports. Vulnerability management and the external penetration tests we commission

- Detection and response. Knowing we are under attack while it is happening and what happens next. Alerting, intrusion detection, incident process and the on-call path

- Cloud and platform hardening. Access control, network boundaries, secrets management, containers and the deployment pipeline. Security through the SDLC: CI/CD, repositories and dependencies

- The security of our APIs. Authentication and authorization, tenant isolation, token scoping and lifecycle, abuse prevention, enterprise SSO and the audit trail our clients and our own accountability depend on

- The security of our AI systems. Prompt injection, tool and agent permissions, our MCP server, retrieval and data ingestion. The data-residency rules we are held to contractually

- Identity and company security. SSO, MFA and privileged access for employees, onboarding and offboarding, access reviews, MDM, endpoint security and SaaS access. The practical IT security a company our size needs done, not discussed

- Secure design across the pods. Threat modelling and design review that enables engineers rather than gatekeeping them and raises the standard of what they ship

- The security function itself. Set the priorities and the roadmap from actual risk, not security theatre. Decide what we build, buy, automate or leave for later. Grow the team and hire into it, represent security to enterprise clients and carry our SOC 2 programme on Drata. Compliance is part of the job and it is not the centre of it

🚢 What you'll secure

- An AI search and recommendation engine for major travel enterprises: enterprise integration, SSO, client security reviews, GDS integrations

- A content enrichment API sold as SaaS: high scale, public facing, data and AI heavy

- The platform underneath: a client console with organisations, projects and API tokens, supplier and business-client integrations, data ingestion, an MCP server, and several LLM providers behind a single internal library

📚 Our stack

- Backend: Go monorepo (no framework, 3+ services)

- Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, Redis Asynq queue

- Hosting: PaaS-managed containers, Cloudflare in front

- Observability: Jaeger tracing, BetterStack for logging, alerting and on-call

- Compliance: Drata, SOC 2 in progress

- AI tooling: Claude Code, used across the whole team

✅ You must have

- 5+ years of hands-on security work spanning more than one discipline. Not five years of engineering with some security in it. This role sets the standard for the company, so it needs someone who has seen enough to have judgement rather than opinions

- Application security depth. You know how modern web applications and APIs are attacked. You can validate an issue yourself through code review or a targeted penetration test and work with the engineer on the fix

- A strong grasp of authentication and authorization. OAuth and OIDC, sessions, token handling, access control and the failure modes behind most API breaches

- Cloud security fundamentals, properly. Identity, network, workload and pipeline security on a modern cloud platform, applied to production systems you were responsible for

- Defensive experience alongside the offensive. You have investigated real incidents. You have built or improved the detection and alerting that catches them

- Threat modelling and secure architecture for cloud, container and API systems

- An engineering background. You are comfortable in a codebase, you can review what our engineers and our AI tools produce and you can build what you need yourself. Our backend is Go. Prior Go experience is a plus and not a requirement

- Comfort in resource-constrained environments. Startups, small security teams or consultancies taught you to prioritize on risk, business impact and available resources and to execute yourself

- The appetite to build a team. You want to grow this function and eventually lead it. Prior leadership experience is a plus and not a requirement. We would rather have depth and develop the leadership than the reverse

- Working proficiency with Claude Code. Share specific examples

- Judgement about pace. You secure a company that ships daily without becoming the reason it stops. Guardrails over gates

- Experience of SOC 2, ISO 27001 or demanding enterprise security reviews

- Excellent spoken and written English. You will talk to auditors, client security teams and our own engineers, often in the same week

- ⚠️ European or African time zones (±3 hours from CET)

- Available full-time (40 hours per week)

🌟 Nice to have

- AI and LLM security: prompt injection, agent and tool permissions, model security, retrieval pipelines. Very few security roles let you both use AI as your main tool and secure it as your subject. This one does

- Early security hire experience. You have been the first or one of the first security hires at a startup or scale-up

- Experience leading or mentoring security engineers

- Go

- Security tooling or automation you built yourself

- MDM, endpoint protection and identity provider administration (Google Workspace or similar)

- Compliance automation tooling (Drata, Vanta, Secureframe or similar)

- Security certifications. Valued as a signal, never required

- GDPR depth. Travel or GDS exposure

- German

❤️ You are a great fit if you

- See security as an engineering discipline. You ship fixes and guardrails, not slide decks

- Can explain a vulnerability to an engineer and its business risk to a client's security lead in the same afternoon

- Have done offensive work as a penetration tester or consultant and wanted broader ownership than producing reports

- Want to build something and own it, rather than advise on someone else's

- Are comfortable challenging unnecessary security bureaucracy and genuinely risky engineering decisions alike

- Get frustrated when a security fix takes weeks instead of days

- Lead and grow a team of 6-8 engineers across embedded software, electrical and mechanical engineering: 1:1s, performance reviews, compensation input, hiring and, when needed, structured performance management

- Build a resilient team structure: develop tech leads, keep yourself off the critical path of IC work, and reduce bus factor on certification and hardware knowledge

Your Profile ✨ 

- Several years of experience managing embedded, firmware or hardware-adjacent engineering teams, including hiring, performance reviews and difficult personnel conversations

- A solid engineering background in embedded systems: you have shipped firmware or devices to production and can hold a technical argument with strong, opinionated senior engineers

- Comfort with the physical side of the product: electronics, EMC, test labs, manufacturing. You do not need to design circuits, but this world must not be foreign to you

- Demonstrated experience working with certification bodies, notified bodies or regulated products - or the appetite and rigor to own this quickly

- Outstanding self-organization: this role has many parallel threads (people, releases, audits, vendors, factory), and following through reliably is the single most important skill

- A track record of building self-managing teams: delegating, developing tech leads and staying off the critical path rather than being the hero

- Excellent communication skills in English, from firmware engineers to executives to external auditors

Nice to have

- Experience in EV charging or e-mobility: OCPP, ISO 15118, Eichrecht, smart charging

- Experience working with contract manufacturers and owning production or end-of-line testing

- Experience managing multi-generation products (legacy fleet plus new platform in parallel)

- The opportunity to play a key role in shaping the mobility revolution

- Work on products that have a direct impact on the future of sustainable transportation

- Be part of an international and dynamic team of more than 30 nationalities

title: Chief Science Officer
description:
Chief Science Officer @ Sereact 🦾 

Chief Science Officer (m/f/d) · Zurich or Stuttgart, Boston possible · Reports to the CEO · Full-time

Who we are 

Sereact builds the robot brain for physical work. Cortex , our vision-language-action foundation model, is hardware-agnostic: the same model runs single-arm and dual-arm systems, mobile manipulators and humanoids that pick, sort and handle returns in live production across Europe and the US. Customers include Zalando, IKEA, BMW, Rohlik and DHL.

Founded in 2021 in Stuttgart, with an R&D hub in Zurich and a US office in Boston. We have raised more than $145 million, most recently a $116 million Series B led by Headline, with Zalando as a strategic investor. We work in small, senior teams with a flat structure; execution counts more than titles.

Why this role, why now 

Our robots produce data no lab can stage. Our fleet has recorded more than 500 million manipulation interactions in live warehouse operations; Cortex 2.0 was trained on a curated 10 million of them and added a world model that plans before it acts ( arXiv 2604.20246 ). Cortex 2.5 learns a new task from a few demonstrations instead of a training run. Deployments are growing from single robots to fleets, and the research team is growing with them.

We now want one scientific leader who owns the research behind Cortex end to end and turns what our fleet experiences every day into the next step change in what robots can do.

The Real-World Learning Loop is your system 

Sereact is a frontier research lab and a production-grade robotics company in one. Our bet: general-purpose robotic intelligence “must be learned from live deployments” ( The Real-World Learning Loop , Feb 2026). Every stage of that loop is yours to raise:

- In-Situ Policy Execution. Every robot in production runs the current policy, and every shift is an experiment. You decide what the policies expose for learning.

- Continuous Data Acquisition. Robots annotate their own interactions while they work. You decide what is worth recording and which situations the fleet should go and find.

- Data Curation and Learning. Novelty, uncertainty, failures and distribution shift decide what we learn from. You own the curation and the training recipe.

- Evaluation and Policy Redeployment. Updated policies pass validation gates before they return to the fleet. You set the bar, and how fast we can clear it safely.

Every deployment teaches the next one. Your job is to make that loop turn faster and teach more each time.

Responsibilities 

- Set the research agenda for Cortex: vision-language-action models, world models and planning, learning from interaction on real robots, and generalization across tasks and embodiments.

- Make the big bets: which directions get people and compute, and which ones we stop.

- Own the data strategy: the mix of deployment, teleoperation, open-source and synthetic data, and what the fleet collects next.

- Own the compute strategy, from large-scale training to real-time inference on the robot.

- Build the evaluation science: benchmarks that predict performance in a customer’s operation, not only on a leaderboard.

- Build and lead the research organisation in Zurich and Stuttgart: structure, leads, rhythm.

- Set the hiring bar and make Sereact the place the best people in robot learning want to join.

- Take research into production with engineering, so results reach the fleet in weeks and hold up in 24/7 operation.

- Decide with the founders what we publish, open-source or patent, and build our standing at CoRL, RSS, ICRA, NeurIPS and ICML.

- Be Sereact’s scientific voice with customers, partners, universities and investors, and build academic partnerships.

- Partner with the CTO, product and operations, so research, engineering and deployment pull in one direction.

Not in scope, by design 

- Software platform, hardware and field deployment engineering. They stay with the CTO and operations: the CTO owns how we build and ship, you own what we learn next.

- A research lab beside the business. Research at Sereact ends on a robot, ideally at a customer.

- Product roadmap and pricing.

What makes this role hard 

- Research and production compete for the same robots, people and compute. You make that trade-off every week, in the open.

- Cortex is not a blank page. It already runs in customer operations, and our founders are deeply technical. You raise the ceiling of a running system.

- A result counts when it holds up in a customer’s operation, not when the paper is accepted.

Your first 12 months 

- First 90 days: know the fleet, the data and the team; agree the research roadmap with the founders; one evaluation standard everyone uses.

- By month 6: a research organisation with clear ownership and a release rhythm from experiment to fleet.

- By month 12: a new generation of Cortex in customer operations with measurable gains, key senior hires made, and work that puts Sereact on the map of robot learning.

What you bring 

- You have led research in robot learning or embodied AI (VLA models, imitation or reinforcement learning, world models) and built a team around it.

- Your work runs on real robots, ideally outside the lab and for long stretches. You know what breaks first.

- Scientific standing: a strong record at the top venues and a network that great researchers want to join.

- You have made real calls on research bets, data and compute, and stopped what did not work.

description:
Staff Product Manager, Product Discovery Engine 

About Us 

Constructor powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you’ve probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We’re approximately doubling year over year despite the market slowing down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We’re a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.

Job Summary 

We’re looking for a systems-minded Staff Product Manager to take Constructor’s search and discovery to the state of the art — and keep it there — across every retail industry we serve. This is a highly technical, high-leverage role at the core of our Product Discovery Engine chapter: the teams responsible for how we retrieve, understand, and rank the right products for every shopper, on every query, for every customer.

Your job is to raise discovery quality and, through it, our customers’ business metrics. You won’t be measured on features shipped — you’ll be measured on relevance and business outcomes, like conversion, revenue per visit, and search-attributed GMV, moving up.

You’ll start embedded with our Search Quality team, owning its strategy and roadmap and getting deep into the systems that decide what shoppers actually see. Over time, your mandate grows to setting direction for the entire Product Discovery Engine chapter — deciding where we’re heading and why across recall, ranking, query understanding, personalization, and the ML infrastructure underneath. This is a Staff role today with a clear path to Director as you take on chapter-wide leadership.

Search at Constructor is fundamentally a machine learning problem, so this role lives and breathes ML. You’ll partner closely with ML, data science, and engineering to turn the latest research into production wins, keep us ahead of both commercial competitors and academic state of the art, and be the connective tissue that aligns multiple teams — ML Recall, ML Infra, and, over time, teams like CORE, SABR, and Catalog Management — behind a single, coherent vision for great discovery.

If you’re excited about driving innovation across dozens of the world’s largest retailers, being held to relevance and business outcomes, and pushing an already best-in-class product further ahead, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do 

- Own business impact, not features. Drive measurable lift in search-attributed conversion, revenue per visit, and GMV alongside relevance across our customer base.

- Deliver across every retail industry. Move quality and business metrics across all the verticals we serve, accounting for the differences in catalog, language, and shopper intent.

- Keep us at the state of the art. Continuously translate the latest ML / IR research and competitive moves into production wins, and ship SOTA ML / LLM-assisted capabilities that beat our previous best on relevance.

- Set chapter vision and strategy. Define the multi-quarter direction for the Product Discovery Engine — where we’re heading and why — tie it directly to customer business outcomes, and rally teams behind it.

- Lead Search Quality first. Own its strategy and roadmap, driving measurable improvements in the relevance and correctness of results.

- Orchestrate across the pipeline. Unify recall, ranking, query understanding, and personalization behind one definition of quality and one set of business metrics, so improvements compound instead of colliding.

- Turn ML research into production wins. Partner deeply with ML and data science to take models — from candidate generation and recall to LLM-assisted interpretation — from idea to production, balancing accuracy, latency, and cost.

- Make quality measurable and explainable. Build the metrics, evaluation frameworks, and tooling the whole chapter uses to measure, attribute, and explain discovery quality and its business impact.

- Own quality under pressure. Lead investigation and triage when issues arise, and design durable, systemic fixes rather than one-off patches.

- Grow the mandate. Expand into chapter-wide leadership spanning ML Recall, ML Infra, and — over time — teams like CORE, SABR, and Catalog Management.

What Success Looks Like 

Within your first year, you will have:

- Driven measurable lift in search-attributed conversion and revenue per visit — moving business metrics, not just quality metrics.

- Driven measurable business-metric lift (conversion, revenue per visit, GMV) and relevance lift across every major retail vertical we serve .

- Shipped at least one state-of-the-art ML / LLM-assisted capability into production that beats our previous best on relevance.

- Won head-to-head quality benchmarks against every major competitor in the verticals we compete in, with a repeatable, defensible methodology.

- Taken core quality metrics to best-in-class levels and kept them improving quarter over quarter.

Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

The Maps API team builds and maintains the applications and infrastructure responsible for creating and distributing Mapbox maps . Thousands of customers rely on our services to seamlessly handle billions of requests every day, scale in real-time to global events, and enable designers, developers, and analysts to make and share maps we’ve never dreamed of.

Delivering maps means delivering a model of the world that’s changing all the time and needs to automatically support the world’s edge cases – writing systems, fonts, local regulations, and global boundary disputes.

Our team maintains the highest-traffic read APIs at Mapbox and the distributed ETL pipelines used by internal and external customers to turn data into maps. We’re building new ways for people to visualize location data. Check out our Mapbox maps !

As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. Our interview process will include discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow.

What You’ll Do 

As a Software Development Engineer III on the Maps API team, you will be responsible for balancing rapid development of new mapping tools against the reliability of our services as they scale into new request volumes, markets, and use cases. In a single week on the Maps API team, you might write application code robust to a world’s worth of data, build and deploy microservices, diagnose complex system behavior as global markets drive traffic in unexpected ways, or facilitate continuous delivery at Mapbox.

In this role, you can expect to:

- Lead your engineering team to identify and scope out well-defined tasks.

- Execute on the scope and be accountable for delivering on time with quality.

- Design systems and make architectural decisions that will keep pace with the rapid growth of Mapbox’s customer base.

- Uphold a culture of collaboration, transparency, creativity, inclusion, and data-driven decisions.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role 

- 8-10+ years of experience building scalable high volume low latency backend services.

- Experience building mapping and geospatial related products.

- Familiarity with code versioning tools, such as GitHub.

- Able to perform independently all the development tasks, based on designs and specs.

- Self-starter who is communication and outcomes-oriented.

- High quality mindset -- write unit tests, proactively remedy defects and follow through to production.

Nice to Have Traits for This Role

title: Senior RF Engineer
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good. 

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

You will be the technical authority for RF hardware behind Dedrone's airspace security products — the RF detection sensors that find and classify drones, and the countermeasure systems that defeat them. You own the hard RF problems end to end: wideband receive chains, high-power transmit chains, and their physical realization on board. You do not carry direct reports, but you technically lead a group of RF hardware engineers and antenna designers — you set the standards they design to, review their work, and grow their capability. This is a hands-on role. You will spend real time in simulation, on the bench, and in the chamber.

What You'll Do

Location: This role is based out of our Kassel office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.
Reports to: Director RF Engineering

- Own RF front-end architecture from VHF through SHF: link budgets, frequency planning, spurious and intermodulation analysis, sensitivity and dynamic-range trade-offs.

- Design and characterize mixers, high-power amplifiers, filters, and switching networks against demanding linearity, efficiency, and thermal targets.

- Drive board-level simulation (EM, circuit, and co-simulation) and take designs through multi-layer RF PCB layout, stack-up definition, and fabrication release.

- Lead bring-up, characterization, and design-for-test; close the loop between simulated and measured performance.

- Set and enforce RF design standards, review checklists, and documentation practice across the group.

- Mentor RF HW engineers and antenna designers; raise the technical bar through design reviews rather than rework.

- Partner with DSP, software, mechanical, and systems engineering, and with regulatory/compliance on CE, FCC, and MIL-STD qualification.

- Advise leadership on technology direction, build-vs-buy, and technical risk.

What You Bring

- 10+ years in RF hardware design, with a track record of products shipped to volume.

- Deep expertise across VHF, UHF, and SHF — not just one band.

- Demonstrated design ownership of mixers and high-power amplifiers above 10 W.

- Strong command of RF simulation tooling — EM and circuit solvers (e.g. ADS, AWR, HFSS, CST) — and the judgment to know when simulation is telling you the truth.

- Multi-layer RF PCB design: controlled impedance, material selection, grounding, isolation, thermal management.

- Fluent with VNAs, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and power measurement; comfortable debugging from first principles.

- Proven technical leadership of a design group — setting direction and standards, mentoring, running rigorous design reviews.

- Degree in Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, or equivalent.

Nice to have

- Antenna design and integration — element and array design, platform effects, radiation-pattern measurement.

- Direction-finding techniques (amplitude/phase comparison, interferometry, TDOA, AoA estimation).

- Beamforming across approaches: analog, digital, and hybrid; phased arrays and adaptive/null-steering methods.

- Hands-on experience with SDR platforms.

- Experience developing and qualifying products for regulated markets — CE, FCC, and/or MIL-STD.

- Working knowledge of DSP concepts sufficient to trade functionality between analog and digital domains.

title: Senior Mechanical Systems Engineer (all genders)
description:
Your Mission: 

We are looking for a Senior Mechanical Systems Engineer (all genders) to help us design and develop the mechanical systems on board our fully battery-electric aircraft (CS-23). You will contribute to the definition and development of key aircraft mechanical systems, including the Environmental Control System, landing gear, ice protection, interiors and other mechanical systems. Your work will span the full system development lifecycle, from system-level requirements, architecture and functional analysis through preliminary and detailed design, supplier involvement, testing and certification. You will work closely with overall aircraft design, structures, flight physics, propulsion and other engineering teams to ensure optimal system integration and will play a key role in the detailed definition of the overall aircraft.

Your Day-to-Day: 

- Define and derive system-level requirements for mechanical aircraft systems based on CONOPS, aircraft-level requirements and applicable regulations.

- Perform system-level functional analysis, including functional decomposition and identification of system interfaces.

- Contribute to the definition and development of mechanical systems to achieve the required level of maturity at each aircraft design phase.

- Define and manage functional and physical interfaces between mechanical systems and other aircraft disciplines.

- Collaborate with partners and suppliers as a technical interface for mechanical systems.

- Support Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA) and system safety activities in accordance with ARP4754A, ARP4761A and applicable certification requirements.

- Support system integration, verification, testing and certification activities.

Your Profile: 

- Engineering degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.

- 8+ years of aerospace experience, with a focus on aircraft mechanical systems.

- Experience with systems engineering, including requirements definition, functional analysis and system integration.

- Knowledge and experience in mechanical aircraft systems, preferably cabin Environmental Control System and/or landing gear.

- Experience across the aircraft development lifecycle, including EASA/FAA Part 23 or 25 certification.

- Experience working in an EASA Part 21J organization, or international equivalent.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; another European language is a plus.

- Proactive, solution-oriented and comfortable taking ownership in a fast-paced environment.

- Passionate about aviation and the electrification of flight.

- Experience with electric or hybrid-electric aircraft and strong understanding of aircraft systems.

title: Content Creator & Social Media Manager (m/w/d) – Fußball Amateur- & Profisport
description:
Mach Vereinsgeschichten sichtbar

Du fühlst Dich auf dem Sportplatz wohl, gehst gerne auf Menschen zu und hast Ideen für Videos, die man sich bis zum Ende anschaut? Du stehst selbst gerne vor der Kamera und kannst Deine Inhalte eigenständig drehen und schneiden?

Wir bei stickerfive entwickeln und produzieren individuelle Stickeralben für den Amateur- und Profisport sowie für Unternehmen und besondere Themenwelten. Bei uns bekommen Vereinsmitglieder ihren eigenen Sticker, Fans sammeln ihre Mannschaft und am Spielfeldrand wird getauscht.

Dahinter stecken Geschichten, die wir auf Social Media bisher viel zu selten erzählen. Unsere Kanäle und unsere Reichweite möchten wir deshalb gezielt ausbauen. Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der diesen Bereich mit eigenen Ideen und praktischer Erfahrung voranbringt.

Deine Aufgaben

- Content entwickeln und produzieren: Du setzt Ideen für Reels, TikToks und Stories um. Vom Konzept über den Dreh bis zum Schnitt und zur Veröffentlichung begleitest Du Deine Inhalte selbst.

- Vor der Kamera stehen: Du stellst unsere Sammelaktionen vor, führst kurze Interviews und gibst Einblicke in den Alltag bei stickerfive.

- Vereine begleiten: Du besuchst Fotoshootings, Verkaufsstarts und Tauschbörsen. Dabei fängst Du die Stimmung ein und kommst mit den Menschen vor Ort ins Gespräch.

- Unsere Kanäle betreuen: Du entwickelst einen Redaktionsplan, veröffentlichst regelmäßig und kümmerst Dich um Kommentare und Nachrichten.

- Reichweite und Community aufbauen: Du entwickelst wiederkehrende Formate und Inhalte, die Menschen gerne anschauen, teilen und kommentieren. Passende Trends greifst Du auf und übersetzt sie in Ideen für stickerfive.

- Ergebnisse auswerten: Du schaust Dir an, welche Inhalte funktionieren, und leitest daraus Verbesserungen ab. Dabei interessieren Dich beispielsweise Wiedergabedauer, geteilte Beiträge und die Entwicklung unserer Community.

- Drehs und Inhalte organisieren: Du stimmst Dich mit unseren Vereinen sowie mit Grafik, Projektmanagement und Vertrieb ab. Du planst Termine und kümmerst Dich rechtzeitig um die Informationen und Materialien, die Du benötigst.

Was du mitbringst

Du hast bereits selbst Social-Media-Inhalte produziert und kannst uns konkrete Beispiele zeigen. Ob für ein Unternehmen, einen Verein oder Deinen eigenen Kanal, ist dabei zweitrangig. Uns interessiert, was Du selbst umgesetzt hast und was Du daraus gelernt hast.

Außerdem wünschen wir uns:

- Interesse am Sport, besonders am Amateur- und Vereinsleben. Vielleicht bist Du selbst im Verein aktiv oder begleitest schon eine Mannschaft mit der Kamera.

- Freude daran, vor der Kamera zu sprechen und auch auf fremde Menschen offen zuzugehen.

- Einen sicheren Umgang mit Smartphone oder Kamera und einem Schnittprogramm wie CapCut, Premiere Pro oder DaVinci Resolve.

- Ein Gespür für gute Einstiege, verständliche Geschichten und das passende Tempo eines Videos.

- Gute deutsche Ausdrucksfähigkeit, sowohl beim Sprechen als auch beim Schreiben.

- Eine selbstständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise. Du bringst Ideen ein, organisierst deren Umsetzung und sprichst offene Fragen oder Hindernisse frühzeitig an.

- Bereitschaft zu Drehs bei unseren Partnervereinen, in der Regel am Wochenende.

Eine bestimmte Ausbildung oder ein Studium setzen wir nicht voraus. Deine Arbeitsproben und Deine Fähigkeiten zählen. Eine große eigene Followerschaft brauchst Du ebenfalls nicht.

Erfahrung mit bezahlter Werbung ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Du hast bereits mit Meta Ads oder TikTok Ads gearbeitet und Kampagnen zur Gewinnung neuer Interessenten betreut? Dann kannst Du diese Erfahrung bei uns einbringen und je nach Kenntnisstand auch Kampagnen übernehmen. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Content und dem Aufbau unserer Social-Media-Kanäle.

Dein Gestaltungsspielraum

Unser Social-Media-Auftritt (Facebook & Instagram) ist ziemlich mau. Auf TikTok sind wir noch nicht aktiv. Du kannst deshalb von Beginn an mitprägen, wie stickerfive auftritt.

Vielleicht begleitest Du eine Mannschaft, die zum ersten Mal ihr eigenes Album sieht. Vielleicht entwickelst Du ein Interviewformat am Spielfeldrand oder zeigst, wie aus einem Mannschaftsfoto ein Sticker wird. Wir suchen jemanden, der solche Ideen mitbringt und sie umsetzt.

Gemeinsam legen wir Ziele und Prioritäten fest. Du bekommst Raum, neue Formate auszuprobieren, und arbeitest eng mit den Menschen zusammen, die unsere Sammelprojekte betreuen.

Das erwartet Dich bei uns

- Geschichten direkt aus dem Sport: Du lernst Amateurvereine kennen und erhältst Einblicke in unsere Projekte mit dem Profisport.

- Kreativer Freiraum: Du entwickelst eigene Formate und prägst den Auftritt von stickerfive mit.

- Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen: Du arbeitest direkt mit Grafik, Projektmanagement und Vertrieb zusammen.

- Abwechslung zwischen Büro und Sportplatz: Dein Arbeitsplatz ist in Gräfelfing bei München. Wie oft Du wirklich am Ende vor Ort in Gräfelfing bei München oder im Homeoffice bist, kommt auf Deinen Wohnort an. Für Drehs bist Du auch bei unseren Partnervereinen unterwegs.

- Ausstattung und Flexibilität: Du erhältst ein Firmenhandy und bei Bedarf auch einen Firmenlaptop. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten stimmen wir passend zu Drehs und Teamterminen ab.

- Gemeinsame Erlebnisse: Ob Stadionbesuch oder Wiesn, auch außerhalb unserer Projekte unternehmen wir etwas zusammen.

- Extras im Arbeitsalltag: Kostenlose Getränke und Kaffee sowie Mitarbeiterrabatte gehören ebenfalls dazu.

Zeig uns, was Du machst

Schick uns Deinen Lebenslauf oder einen kurzen Überblick über Deinen bisherigen Weg sowie Arbeitsproben. Besonders interessieren uns Videos, die Du selbst konzipiert, gedreht oder geschnitten hast. Bei gemeinsamen Projekten schreib bitte kurz dazu, welche Aufgaben Du übernommen hast.

Mindestens eines der Beispiele sollte Dich vor der Kamera zeigen. Falls Du dazu noch nichts Passendes hast, reicht auch ein kurzes Vorstellungsvideo mit dem Smartphone.

Erzähl uns außerdem, welchen Bezug Du zum Sport hast, wann Du anfangen könntest und welchen Stundenumfang und welches Gehalt Du Dir vorstellst.

Bewirb Dich direkt hier über die Plattform oder kontaktiere uns über unsere Kanäle

title: Senior Marketing Manager SaaS/AI Startup f/m/d
description:
About PULT

PULT is the Workplace Presence & Visitor Platform for fast growing companies. We help IT, Workplace and People teams understand who is actually in the office, run compliant visitor management, and make better decisions about their space.

We are a Hamburg-based B2B SaaS company, backed by strong investors, with customers like VEVO, Wellhub and SG Fleet. We are post-seed, growing fast, and preparing the next stage of the company. Marketing is one of the biggest levers we have, and it still has a lot of untouched potential. That is where you come in.

Your first months at Pult

We are hiring a senior marketing / growth manager: one person who owns the full funnel, end to end, and scales what works. A bold, AI-native generalist who wants the whole board.

PULT is growing fast and opening international markets. You will turn it into a repeatable, measurable engine, and you will have the mandate, the budget and the backing to do it.

If you have been waiting for the role where you finally get to run marketing rather than a slice of it, this is it.

Your mission:

Demand generation 

- Plan and run paid campaigns across LinkedIn, Google and the channels you discover next, with full ownership of budget and ROI

- Own the website and conversion funnel together with our web agency: messaging, landing pages, experiments

- Build the organic engine: SEO, AI search visibility, content that IT and People leaders actually want to read

- Run our webinar programme and turn it into a reliable pipeline source

Brand and storytelling 

- Sharpen PULT's positioning and make sure every touchpoint tells the same bold story

- Produce standout content: campaigns, videos, case studies, product launches, founder and customer stories

- Set a high bar for design and copy, and hold the team and agencies to it

Offline and events 

- Take PULT to the events that matter in DACH and the UK, from trade fairs to our own customer dinners and roundtables

- Run account-based campaigns into our target accounts, online and offline, together with Sales

Engine and scale 

- Own the marketing stack (HubSpot, analytics, AI tooling) and the data behind it: attribution, CAC, MQL growth, pipeline contribution

- Use AI as a force multiplier for research, content, creative and ops, and build the agents and workflows that let a small team move like a big one

- Define the marketing roadmap, report on results to the leadership team, and hire the first marketing team members as we scale

What the role requires

- A generalist with range. 3+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, ideally in a scale-up, with hands-on experience across paid, online and offline channels. You have run campaigns, written the copy, briefed the designer and read the dashboard yourself.

- AI-native. You already work with AI every day: for research, content, creative, analysis and automation. You see where the tools are heading and you build with them, not around them.

- High agency. You do not wait for a brief. You get excited by ambitious goals, find the path, and ship.

- A storyteller with taste. Exceptional writing in English (German is a strong plus) and a sharp eye for design. You know the difference between content that fills a calendar and content that moves people.

- Bold. You would rather launch something people talk about than something safe that nobody notices. You bring ideas we have not thought of.

- ROI first. You think in pipeline, not impressions. You are comfortable with budgets, CAC, conversion rates and the conversation with Sales about lead quality.

- International. You have experience in DACH and / or UKI market. You excited about expanding into new markets.

- A builder. You want to be the leading marketing hire, expand on the foundations, and grow into leading a team.

Benefits

This is a remote-first position. You will have access to career training to support your professional development. A company laptop is provided for your daily work. Stay active with a sport membership. Enjoy flexible working hours. Company stock options give you a stake in the company's growth. Paid co-working options are also available.

Compensation

EUR 50,000–65,000 per year

Join PULT

If you match most of these requirements and are ready to shape the future of workplaces across the world, we encourage you to apply. You will be joining an early-stage startup where your contributions directly impact growth and product adoption.

Die Rolle 

Unser Kernprodukt Konsentas ist über viele Jahre gewachsen, und das sieht man dem Code an. Das Backend läuft auf PHP 8.1 ohne Framework. Im Frontend stehen jQuery und Vanilla-JS neben React, und automatisierte Tests gibt es bisher wenige.

Wohin es gehen soll, ist klar: Das Backend wird schrittweise auf Symfony umgestellt, das Frontend auf React vereinheitlicht. Bis Ende 2027 soll die Migration abgeschlossen sein. Was dafür fehlt, ist kein Plan, sondern Kapazität.

- Legacy-Module bei laufendem Betrieb schrittweise durch Symfony-Services und React-Oberflächen ersetzen

- Fullstack-Features von der Datenbank bis zum Frontend entwickeln, teils auch als kundenspezifische Erweiterungen

- Bestehenden Legacy-Code pflegen, debuggen und weiterentwickeln

- Gelegentlich an Kundenterminen teilnehmen, etwa alle 3–4 Wochen

… setzt du Features eigenständig um, hast spürbar zur Modernisierung beigetragen, die Codequalität verbessert und bist für unsere Azubis eine feste Ansprechperson.

Dein Profil 

- Erfahrung: etwa 4–5 Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung (ein Richtwert, keine harte Grenze)

- PHP: fundierte Kenntnisse in modernem PHP 8.x mit objektorientierter Architektur, etwa Dependency Injection, Interfaces und SOLID

- Symfony: nachweisbare Praxiserfahrung mit dem Framework

- Legacy-Code: Du gehst sicher mit gewachsenen Codebasen um. Du refaktorierst, debuggst und entwickelst weiter, ohne alles neu zu schreiben.

- JavaScript/React: solide Erfahrung im Frontend, jQuery schreckt dich nicht ab

- Datenbanken: relationale Datenbanken wie MySQL/MariaDB oder SingleStore und sicherer Umgang mit SQL

- Tooling: Git und Arbeit mit CI/CD

- Sprache: Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, Englisch mindestens B1

- Arbeitsweise: eigenständig, strukturiert, proaktiv und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch

- Persönlich: Du kommunizierst verlässlich, arbeitest gern im Team, übernimmst Verantwortung, hast keine Angst vor schwierigen Codestellen und gibst dein Wissen gern weiter.

- Abschluss: Ausbildung oder FH-Abschluss zählen bei uns genauso viel wie ein Uni-Studium. Entscheidend ist deine Praxiserfahrung.

Pluspunkte: REST/API-Design und Schnittstellenentwicklung, automatisiertes Testing (PHPUnit, Jest), Docker, Deployment-Pipelines und Cloud, Software-Architektur und Design

-

Patterns, produktiver Einsatz von KI-Tools wie Claude Code oder Codex. Erfahrung mit Software für den öffentlichen Sektor ist nicht nötig.

Dein Team 

Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen: Daniel (Developer Lead), Nico (Geschäftsführer & Projektmanager), der selbst aktiv mitentwickelt, ein externer Entwickler und zwei Auszubildende. Ihr stimmt euch täglich ab. Daniel und Nico übernehmen dein Onboarding persönlich.

Seit über 25 Jahren entwickelt die Girona Softwareentwicklung GmbH in Berlin Software für die öffentliche Verwaltung. Städte wie Berlin, München, Bonn und Dessau setzen seit Jahrzehnten auf unsere Lösungen, Konsentas etwa in Bürgerämtern, Gesundheitsämtern sowie Kfz-Zulassungs- und Führerscheinstellen.

What you learn in the field, you turn into building blocks the whole team ships with.

title: Strategische:r Einkäufer:in – Halbleitermaterialien (w/m/d)
description:
Über uns 

Wir sehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum der Möglichkeiten. Wir sehen Chancen. Wir sehen die tiefgreifenden Auswirkungen, die unsere Graphen-Lösungen auf die Umgestaltung der Branche habenwerden. Wir laden dich ein, mit uns gemeinsam den Wandel voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Die Vision lautet: Beweise allen, dass du etwas grundlegend verändern kannst. Beweise mit deinem Wissen und deinen Fähigkeiten, wie Dinge anders gemacht werden können. Gemeinsam können wir das Paradigma, wie die Welt zusammenhängt, verändern.

Unsere Technologie 

Die wachsende Nachfrage der Halbleiterindustrie nach leistungsfähigeren Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Stromverbrauch findet ihre Lösung in unserer Technologie. Wir verbinden Chips mit Computernetzwerken mit hohem Durchsatz und geringer Verzögerung. Der Schlüssel liegt in der Nutzung der physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu verbinden, so dass zahllose Chips miteinander interagieren können, als wären sie ein einziger. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation steigert die Rechenleistung und Effizienz in einer neuen Größenordnung.

Kurz gesagt , wir verbinden Chips zu leistungsstarken und energieeffizienten Netzwerken und überwinden so die Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie mittels Graphen.

Deine Rolle 

In dieser Position verantwortest du die strategische Beschaffung und das Lieferantenmanagement für Materialien, die für die Fertigung von Halbleitern unverzichtbar sind. Du stellst die Versorgungssicherheit sicher, optimierst die Gesamtkosten über den gesamten Beschaffungslebenszyklus hinweg und gewährleistest die Einhaltung der Qualitätsanforderungen. Dabei berücksichtigst du sowohl die sich stets weiterentwickelnden technologischen Anforderungen als auch die Veränderungen der Marktbedingungen.

Deine Aufgaben 

- Deine Hauptaufgabe ist es, globale Beschaffungsstrategien für Halbleitermaterialien wie Wafer, Fotolacke, CMP-Suspensionen, Spezialgase oder Chemikalien zu entwickeln und zu implementieren.

- Du identifizierst, qualifizierst und steuerst strategisch wichtige Lieferanten und stellst dabei sicher, dass sie optimal auf unsere Technologie-Roadmaps, Qualitätsstandards und Produktionsanforderungen abgestimmt sind.

- Beim Verhandeln von Verträgen, Preisen und sonstigen Konditionen hast du unsere Kostenziele immer im Blick und sicherst gleichzeitig eine verlässliche Belieferung.

- Darüber hinaus beobachtest du kontinuierlich die Märkte für Halbleitermaterialien, die Leistung der Lieferanten, Preistrends sowie Risiken in der Lieferkette, um Chancen frühzeitig zu erkennen und gezielte Maßnahmen zur Risikominderung zu entwickeln.

- In enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Teams aus R&D, Process Engineering, Qualitätssicherung und Fertigung stimmst du die Materialbeschaffung bestmöglich auf die technologischen Vorgaben und Produktionsanforderungen ab.

- Bei der Einführung neuer Produkte unterstützt du tatkräftig, indem du Materialien beschaffst, die den neuen Prozessanforderungen und Skalierungszielen gerecht werden.

- Du steuerst die Performance, pflegst die Lieferantenbeziehungen und kümmerst dich um das Reporting in Bezug auf unsere Unternehmensziele.

Das bringst du mit 

- Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Supply Chain Management, Ingenieur- oder Materialwissenschaften, Physik, BWL (oder ein vergleichbarer Studiengang)

- Mind. 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Einkauf, Strategic Sourcing oder Supply Chain Management, vorzugsweise in der Halbleiterindustrie, Elektronikbranche oder Hightech-Fertigung

- Fundierte Kenntnisse und Erfolge in Bezug auf Vertragsverhandlungen, Lieferantenmanagement und Kostenoptimierung

- Ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Halbleitermaterialien und -prozesse, z. B. Wafer, Spezialgase, Chemikalien, Fotolacke, Lithografie, Ätzen und Metallisierungsmaterialien

- Erste praktische Erfahrungen im Umgang mit ERP- oder Einkaufssystemen und Datenanalysetools

- Analytisches Denken, Kommunikationsstärke und ein gutes Gespür im Umgang mit verschiedenen Stakeholder:innen

- Verhandlungssicheres Englisch (Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus)

- Die Bereitschaft, mind. 1x pro Woche in unserem Aachener Büro zu arbeiten

Unsere Kultur 

Menschen vor Prozessen. Bei Black Semiconductor ist Flexibilität der Schlüssel — wir sorgen dafür, dass sich die Arbeit dem Leben anpasst und nicht umgekehrt. Wir setzen uns für die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben ein, damit Karrieren sinnvoll und bereichernd sind. Unsere Prozesse sind menschenzentriert, damit du dich auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren kannst.

Lass uns gemeinsam wachsen. Dein Potenzial ist unsere Priorität. Wir bieten dir die nötige Autonomie, um etwas zu bewirken, und fördern dein Wachstum durch eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens. Wir investieren in deine berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung.

Deine Gesundheit und deine Zukunft sind uns wichtig. Dein Wohlbefinden steht an erster Stelle. Wir bieten dir ein umfassendes Leistungspaket mit hervorragenden Versicherungs-, Renten- und virtuellen Aktienoptionen für deine geistige, körperliche und finanzielle Gesundheit. Dein Wohlbefinden ist unsere Priorität — heute und in der Zukunft.

Wir leben Offenheit. Zusammenarbeit und Inklusion sind die Eckpfeiler unserer Kultur. Wir praktizieren Offenheit und fördern Vertrauen und Respekt. Individualität ist unsere kollektive Stärke, die uns zu Innovationen antreibt und uns voranbringt.

Wir verbinden Chips — und Menschen. Wir ermutigen qualifizierte Personen mit beliebigem Hintergrund, sich zu bewerben. Wir fördern ein integratives und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, das Zusammenarbeit, Innovation und Wachstum schätzt. Working in a cleanroom environment, you will collaborate with process, equipment and integration teams to set up, qualify and optimize inspection recipes, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve defect detection and classification.

What You’ll Do 

- Perform AOI and unpatterned wafer inspection on materials such as bare silicon, epitaxial layers and polished wafers

- Set up, qualify and optimize inspection recipes

- Fine-tune inspection tool and recipe parameters to improve defect-detection sensitivity, inspection quality, repeatability and overall performance

- Analyze defect data to identify trends, root causes and potential process excursions

- Interpret defect data and translate findings into actionable insights for process teams

- Generate defect maps, Pareto charts and reports to communicate findings

- Participate in Design of Experiments (DOE) to optimize inspection parameters

- Troubleshoot inspection-related issues and support continuous improvement in defect detection and classification

- Collaborate with process, equipment and integration teams

What You Bring 

- A bachelor’s degree or above in electrical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field

- 5+ years of experience in semiconductor inspection, with a focus on AOI and unpatterned wafer inspection

- Hands-on experience with unpatterned wafer inspection systems, such as SPx, and AOI tools such as Eagle or Dragonfly

- Understanding of semiconductor process flows, including polishing, epitaxy and cleaning

- Familiarity with defect classification, SEM review and Statistical Process Control (SPC)

- Proficiency in AOI and defect-review software, such as KLA Klarity and Camtek Inspecta

- Ability to optimize inspection tools and recipe parameters for sensitivity, inspection quality and repeatability

- Ability to interpret defect data and identify relevant trends and improvement opportunities

- Proficiency in JMP for statistical analysis, data visualization and DOE

- Familiarity with MATLAB or Python is an advantage

- Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions

What We Offer 

- The opportunity to work on defect inspection for an integrated graphene photonics process flow
