description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. 

Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success. 

Kpler is expanding into high-value maritime verticals, with Cruise Liners and Port Operations representing two important opportunities. Both address a common market need: the lack of independent, reliable insights into actual performance, built on observed data rather than published schedules or self-reported information.

In the cruise sector, operators and analysts often rely on published itineraries rather than actual vessel movements, despite the significant fuel and carbon costs associated with fleet operations. In ports, performance data is often incomplete or self-reported, creating a need for independent benchmarking as berth-level emissions carry increasing financial implications under schemes such as the EU ETS.

As a Senior Product Manager, Cruise Liners & Port Operations, you will own both products end to end, from strategy and roadmap through to the first release and go-to-market. Working closely with the Lead Product Manager – Maritime & Logistics, you will build two early-stage products in parallel, leveraging Kpler’s network of more than 13,000 AIS receivers and over 10,000 mapped ports and berths.

For Cruise Liners, you will develop itinerary intelligence for tracked fleets, providing an independent view of actual sailed itineraries, fuel consumption and emissions. For Port Operations, you will build a product focused on port-level vessel activity monitoring, giving port authorities a reliable, live view of activity and performance.

This is an individual-contributor role for an experienced product professional with a background in maritime, cruise, travel, ports or an adjacent B2B data/SaaS environment. You will need to balance competing priorities across two products, establish trusted data methodologies, engage customers and bring both products to market through a pragmatic, build-and-iterate approach.

Key Responsibilities 

- Own the product strategy and roadmap for Cruise Liners and Port Operations, prioritising customer needs and commercial opportunities while making trade-offs between the two products explicit.

- Lead market discovery with cruise operators, port authorities, harbour masters and terminal operators, gathering requirements and translating customer needs into product priorities.

- Drive delivery across both products, maintaining clear roadmaps, delivery cadences and launch plans, with a pragmatic approach focused on launching initial capabilities and iterating based on feedback.

- Establish trusted data and benchmarking methodologies for both products, developing an independent view of cruise itineraries, fuel and emissions, alongside consistent port call-cycle measurement and performance benchmarking.

- Collaborate with Engineering, Data, Sales, Product Marketing and other product teams to align delivery, reuse shared data and emissions capabilities, and develop early data and distribution partnerships.

- Define the Cruise Liners product direction, delivering fleet itinerary intelligence based on live, observed vessel movements that reflects actual sailed journeys rather than published schedules.

- Build the Port Operations product, providing port authorities with a reliable, live view of vessel activity using Kpler’s AIS receiver network and mapped port and berth data.

- Develop product positioning and competitive strategy, identifying opportunities to differentiate Kpler’s independent, first-party observed data from existing cruise analytics and port operations offerings.

- Drive go-to-market execution for both products, working with Product Marketing on positioning, packaging, pricing input and launch planning, and establishing repeatable customer discovery and design partnerships.

Skills & Experience 

- 6–10 years of senior product or commercial experience in maritime data, cruise or travel, ports, or an adjacent B2B data/SaaS business, with a proven track record of delivering products that customers adopt.

- Working fluency in at least one of cruise or port operations, with the ability to develop expertise quickly in the other.

- Direct experience in the cruise or ports industry, with an established network among operators, port authorities and terminals.

- Experience translating customer needs into product strategy and working closely with product and engineering teams to deliver solutions.

- Experience managing multiple products or workstreams simultaneously, balancing competing priorities and maintaining delivery momentum.

- Strong product discovery and roadmap prioritisation skills, with the ability to engage customers and translate market insights into actionable product requirements.

- Experience working with data and engineering teams to deliver data-driven products.

- Understanding of go-to-market planning, including product positioning, packaging and pricing input.

- Familiarity with maritime and trade data concepts, including AIS, port calls and voyage legs.

- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage technical and commercial teams and senior external stakeholders.

- A self-directed approach, with strong ownership, sound judgement and a pragmatic bias towards action.

- Comfort working in an ambiguous, early-stage environment, with a build-and-iterate mindset.

Nice to have 

- Experience launching a new product line or building a product from concept to market, rather than solely managing an established offering.

- Understanding of the regulatory environment shaping maritime and port operations, including the EU ETS, FuelEU Maritime, CII and green port incentive schemes.

- Experience establishing customer design partnerships and building relationships with industry stakeholders to support product discovery and adoption.

description:

Au sein de l'équipe Field Marketing, vous jouez un rôle central dans la conception et l'orchestration d'événements à fort impact pour Doctolib, partout en France. 
Votre mission : faire de l'événementiel un levier puissant de notoriété, d'engagement et de performance commerciale, en portant une vision créative et ambitieuse de chaque activation.

En tant que Senior Events Manager, vous apportez bien plus qu'une expertise en gestion de projets événementiels : vous insufflez des idées de concepts originaux et différenciants, capables de marquer les esprits et de renforcer durablement notre présence dans l'écosystème de santé. Vous pilotez des événements de grande envergure, de la conception jusqu'à l'exécution terrain, avec une exigence de qualité et d'impact à chaque étape.

Vous prenez en charge le cycle de vie complet d'événements stratégiques B2B tels que des congrès, salons médicaux, keynotes produit, webinars ou événements propriétaires. Vous êtes force de proposition sur les formats, les expériences et les dispositifs qui permettront à Doctolib de se démarquer, tout en garantissant une exécution irréprochable sur le terrain.

En transverse, vous collaborez étroitement avec les équipes Sales, Product Marketing, Growth, Brand & Content et Sales Enablement pour garantir que chaque événement est cohérent avec les priorités business, bien ancré dans les réalités commerciales et pensé pour générer un impact mesurable. Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à : 

- Concevoir et piloter un portefeuille d'événements B2B stratégiques en apportant à chaque projet une vision créative forte et des concepts innovants, de l'idée initiale à l'exécution terrain.

- Proposer des formats événementiels différenciants, en imaginant des expériences mémorables qui reflètent l'ambition et les valeurs de Doctolib, tout en répondant aux objectifs business.

- Prendre en charge l'intégralité de la production événementielle : planification, coordination des parties prenantes internes et externes, pilotage des prestataires, gestion des livrables et supervision sur le terrain.

- Définir et déployer des plans d'activation alignés avec les priorités commerciales, en adaptant les formats et les concepts selon les audiences, les territoires et les objectifs visés.

- Mesurer la performance des événements à travers des indicateurs clés tels que les leads générés, le pipeline influencé, les taux de conversion ou le ROI, et recommander des optimisations concrètes basées sur les résultats.

- Coordonner de multiples parties prenantes, internes comme externes, pour garantir la qualité d'exécution, l'alignement stratégique et la fluidité de déploiement.

Les qualités attendues pour ce poste

Vous serez particulièrement à l’aise dans ce rôle si vous : 

- Disposez d'au moins 6 ans d'expérience en events management, field marketing, marketing B2B, avec des réalisations concrètes sur des événements à fort impact et de grande envergure.

- Avez une vraie sensibilité créative et une capacité démontrée à imaginer et concevoir des concepts événementiels originaux, qui sortent des sentiers battus et créent une expérience mémorable.

- Maîtrisez le pilotage de projets complexes de bout en bout, comme des congrès, salons, keynotes ou événements propriétaires, avec une présence terrain forte et un sens aigu du détail.

- Savez évoluer à la fois à un niveau stratégique et opérationnel, en passant de la conception créative à une exécution terrain irréprochable, sans jamais perdre de vue l'impact business.

- Êtes à l'aise dans la gestion de projets complexes, avec des budgets significatifs, de multiples parties prenantes et des délais exigeants.

- Avez une forte orientation business, comprenez les enjeux de croissance et savez travailler en proximité avec les équipes Sales pour soutenir la génération d'opportunités et la performance commerciale.

- Maîtrisez la mesure de la performance, la définition de KPIs, l'analyse de résultats et la traduction d'insights en plans d'action concrets.

- Une grande rigueur, précision et attention au détail dans l’exécution

title: Lead Marketing Data Analyst (x/f/m)
description:

Nous recherchons un(e) Lead Marketing Data Analyst pour rejoindre l'équipe B2B Performance Marketing. En tant que Lead Marketing Data Analyst, vous êtes la référence analytique de l'équipe sur la performance d'acquisition, l'attribution et la valeur client. 

Vous transformez des données cross-canal complexes en concepts clairs et en recommandations concrètes qui influencent directement les décisions d'investissement, de ciblage et de croissance de l'équipe. Vous êtes également le partenaire des Sales Operations (équipe SCOPS) pour construire l'infrastructure de “lead scoring” qui connecte Marketing et Sales.

Vous évoluez dans un environnement AI-first : les modèles ML, les pipelines automatisés et l'analyse assistée par IA feront partie de votre quotidien.

Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à : 

1. Attribution, parcours de conversion & incrémentalité (30%)

- Piloter le modèle d'attribution multi-touch de l'équipe entre SEO, acquisition payante et CRM

- Construire et maintenir une vue unifiée des parcours de conversion, exploitable depuis le data warehouse

- Définir et documenter les définitions de conversion communes sur lesquelles toute l'équipe s'aligne

2. LTV/SAC, analyses de cohortes & reporting à la Direction (25%)

- Suivre la LTV et le SAC par canal d'acquisition, segment et cohorte

- Construire et maintenir les courbes de rétention par cohorte (J7, J30, J90) et identifier les moments de churn

- Déterminer quelles sources d'acquisition et quels segments génèrent la plus forte valeur à long terme

- Développer des modèles de prévision en collaboration étroite avec les équipes Data et Finance

- Produire le reporting LTV/SAC mensuel qui guide les décisions d'allocation budgétaire et préparer les synthèses de performance partagées avec la Direction

3. Scoring des leads & partenariat avec les équipes commerciales (20%)

- Concevoir et déployer un modèle de scoring des leads basé sur le machine learning avec l'équipe SCOPS, pour déterminer quels leads sont transmis aux commerciaux et lesquels sont nurturés en CRM

- Traduire les données comportementales et d'engagement en un modèle de scoring activable dans le CRM, en coordination avec le spécialiste CRM Tooling & AI 

- Faire évoluer le modèle au fil des nouvelles données et des retours des équipes commerciales

4. Disponibilité de la donnée & support de l'équipe (15%)

- Être le partenaire data du spécialiste CRM Tooling & AI et du Digital Analyst : garantir que la donnée dont ils ont besoin est disponible, bien documentée et fiable

- Traduire leurs besoins en exigences structurées pour les Data Product Managers

- Identifier les problèmes de qualité de données en amont et les suivre jusqu'à leur résolution

- Être le lien entre l'équipe Performance Marketing et l'organisation Data

5. Tableaux de bord opérationnels & suivi de la performance (10%)

- Piloter les tableaux de bord de performance globale de l'équipe : acquisition, attribution, LTV/SAC et contribution par canal (suivi quotidien, pilotage hebdomadaire, vue mensuelle pour la direction)

- Mettre en place une détection automatique des anomalies, des synthèses narratives générées par IA et des analyses exploratoires assistées pour libérer du temps sur des travaux analytiques à plus forte valeur ajoutée

- Stratégie d'acquisition & d'activation

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
About Mirakl: 

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com .

Mirakl in Numbers: 

- 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40

- 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

- 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France

- ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values: 

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

- 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success

- 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results

- 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence

- 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture

- 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job 

Design, build, and scale production-grade AI systems that power the next generation of intelligent commerce.

You will work at the intersection of Software Engineering, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to build AI-native products, agentic systems, and platform capabilities used by Mirakl customers and internal teams.

This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week.

Annual gross salary range (package): €65,000 – €80,000 

This range is provided for transparency purposes and reflects our internal compensation grid for this role level. The final offer will be determined based on your experience, skills, and the scope of responsibilities involved.

Why Now, Why Mirakl 

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to transform the way our internal teams work, and to have a significant impact on the agentic side of our Saas products.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.

What You’ll Do 

1. Design & Build AI Systems 

- Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems for both Mirakl internal operations.

- Develop solutions leveraging: LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Multimodal AI and Evaluation frameworks.

- Architect complex agentic workflows including tools, memory, retrieval, planning, and guardrails.

- Rapidly prototype new capabilities and evolve them into scalable, reliable AI production systems.

2. Integrate Across the Stack 

- Connect AI systems to internal platforms, business applications, and data sources across the company.

- Enable AI agents to interact with systems such as CRM, data platform, Drive, Jira, support tools, and internal knowledge bases.

- Design robust orchestration layers between models, APIs, tools, retrieval systems, and business workflows.

- Ensure reliability, observability, scalability, and maintainability across the entire AI stack.

3. Iterate for Impact 

- Partner with end users, business teams, Product Managers, and Engineers to identify high-value opportunities for AI.

- Run pilots and experiments, gather qualitative and quantitative feedback, and measure business impact.

- Analyze usage patterns, failure modes, costs, latency, and performance metrics.

- Continuously improve accuracy, reliability, adoption, and user experience through data-driven iteration.

4. Ensure Quality, Security & Reliability 

- Implement evaluation frameworks, guardrails, validation layers, and monitoring systems.

- Design AI systems that are secure, explainable, and production-ready.

- Ensure compliance with data security, governance, and access control requirements.

- Document architectures, capabilities, limitations, KPIs, and operational best practices.

5. Drive Adoption & Enablement 

- Build a scalable ecosystem of AI systems and agents that empower both internal teams and customers.

- Support teams in adopting AI-powered workflows and integrating AI into their daily operations.

- Contribute to AI engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the company.

- Act as a champion for AI-driven ways of working and help shape Mirakl's transition toward Agentic Commerce.

Our stack and tools 

- 
Languages: Python and SQL

- 
AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models

- 
Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases

- Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

What Makes You Successful 

- Strong engineering mindset: able to design reliable and scalable systems

- Strong AI expertise: able to translate the latest AI capabilities into production products

- Strong product mindset: able to balance technical excellence with business impact

- Focus on measurable outcomes, not technical complexity

Success Metrics 

- Product adoption and business impact

- Performance and reliability of AI systems

- Quality of AI outputs and evaluation metrics

You'll Love This Job If you have 

- 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, Applied AI, or related fields

- Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals

- Hands-on experience building production AI systems using LLMs, RAG, and AI Agents

- Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and retrieval systems

- Experience evaluating AI systems and improving model performance

- Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments

- Strong communication skills in English

- Curiosity, pragmatism, and passion for building AI products

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

Want to join us? Here is our process 

- A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.

- An initial 1h30 technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.

- 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you’re ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world’s most innovative retailers and B2B organizations. 

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews .

description:

Founded in Switzerland in 2012, SkyCell is transforming global pharmaceutical supply chains through a combination of advanced temperature-controlled containers, IoT connectivity, and digital solutions.

Our integrated product ecosystem helps leading pharmaceutical companies reduce risk, improve operational efficiency, and ensure the safe delivery of life-saving medicines worldwide.

Today, SkyCell operates at the intersection of hardware, software, data, and logistics - combining Swiss engineering excellence with a growing digital platform to shape the future of connected pharma supply chains.

- Troubleshoot complex system-level issues across device, connectivity and cloud layers

- Contribute to architecture and process improvements based on emerging best practices

- Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

- Experience developing embedded firmware in C/C++ (RTOS or bare-metal), with a good understanding of common interfaces (I2C, SPI, UART)

- Experience with wireless protocols (BLE, LoRa or Cellular) and IoT communication protocols and data formats (MQTT, HTTP/REST, CoAP, Protobuf, JSON)

- Experience designing and operating cloud-based ingestion and device fleet management systems for connected IoT devices at scale

- Experience implementing OTA updates in production systems

- Proficiency in a backend language (e.g. Python, Go, Node.js or Java) for device integration, automation and diagnostics, with excellent system-level debugging and problem-solving skills

- Good written and spoken German and English

🌟 Recognition & Growth: Opportunities for career advancement in a company that values your contributions.

title: Solutions Consultant
description:
As OpenSpace's Solutions Consultant for Germany, Austria and Switzerland, you'll be the technical and commercial partner to our Account Executives. You'll win deals by proving the business value of OpenSpace, get new customers live quickly, and drive the adoption that turns first projects into long-term, growing accounts. You'll work across the whole customer lifecycle, from first demo through renewal, with regular visits to customer offices and job sites across the region.

What you will be doing 

- Owning the technical win with the Account Executive, from discovery and tailored demos through to a signed contract

- Scoping, running and closing out pilots and proofs of value, with clear success criteria agreed with the AE and the customer

- Finding and qualifying expansion opportunities in existing accounts and building pipeline with the AE

- Leading the value and ROI conversation at renewal and expansion, using usage data and customer outcomes to build business cases

- Onboarding new customers: project setup, capture training for field teams and admin training for project managers

- Driving adoption after go-live through usage reviews, project check-ins and value reviews with customer stakeholders

- Answering technical, security and data privacy (GDPR) questions, supporting tenders and RFPs, and advising on integrations such as Autodesk Construction Cloud (Forma)

- Bringing market feedback to the Product team and building German-language enablement material with Marketing

What we are looking for 

- A bachelor's degree in civil engineering, construction management, architecture or a related field, or equivalent work experience

- 5+ years in a customer-facing role at a construction technology or AEC software company, or in project or site management at an owner or construction company

- A proven track record in pre-sales, solutions consulting or customer success with shared revenue targets

- Native German and business-fluent English, spoken and written

- Ability to travel regularly to customer offices and job sites across DACH

- A solid understanding of how construction projects run, from preconstruction to handover, including site documentation and progress tracking

- Experience with complex B2B sales cycles, value selling and qualification methods such as MEDDPICC

- Familiarity with construction software such as Autodesk Construction Cloud (Forma) and BIM tools

- Reality capture or 360° imaging experience is a plus

- Knowledge of the DACH construction market and its main contractors is a plus

How you like to work 

- Commercially minded: You spot expansion opportunities, build the ROI case and help the AE move deals forward. You can turn usage data into a clear story about customer value.

- A clear communicator: You adapt your message to site managers, project managers and executives, and you explain technical concepts in plain language.

- Organized and independent: You can run several onboardings and pilots at once, and you're comfortable in a small regional team that works closely with colleagues in other countries and time zones.

If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions .

title: Computational Scientist / Scientific Machine Learning
description:
Fusionality is building the measurement, simulation, and control stack for the fusion energy reactors of the future.

Spun out of EPFL’s Swiss Plasma Center and backed by top investors, our technology enables reliable operation, real-time monitoring, and analysis of high-temperature plasmas in fusion devices. We are founded by world-class experts at the intersection of fusion physics, advanced control, and AI (ex-Google DeepMind, EPFL). We are assembling a founding engineering team in Lausanne to build our core technology platform.

We are looking for a Computational Scientist specialized in Scientific Machine Learning (SciML) to join our team. This job is for you if you know how to write numerical solvers that are fast, correct and differentiable end to end, and want to see them run against real plasma data and inside real control systems.

We are looking for a PhD-level or senior computational researcher for this role.

Responsibilities

- Design, implement and validate differentiable solvers in JAX for plasma physics problems such as free-boundary equilibrium, transport and state estimation.

- Make them robust and fast enough for production use via advanced numerical techniques for differential equation time stepping, as well as optimization of GPU/TPU performance.

- Using automatic differentiation for model calibration against experimental data, parameter estimation and controller design and optimization, working with our data and control engineers.

- Code ownership: quality, testing, verification against reference solutions, packaging and documentation.

Requirements

- Substantial code written in a differentiable framework. Our stack is in JAX, Julia or PyTorch experts are very welcome if they’re happy to switch.

- Strong background in numerical methods for ODEs and PDEs: discretisation, stiff and implicit solvers, nonlinear and sparse linear solvers.

- Demonstrated ability to operate at the frontier of SciML, Universal Differential Equations, Neural ODEs, and other emerging hybrid data-driven/mechanistic paradigms.

- Evidence of independent work at the highest level: a PhD or thesis, published code that is used by others, or an industry project you owned.

- Proficient using Agentic coding and other modern AI technologies to accelerate your work, while remaining accountable for the results.

Experience in the following fields an advantage but not strictly required:

- The JAX ecosystem: Diffrax, Equinox, Optax, Lineax.

- Plasma, fluid, electromagnetic, or other multiphysics simulation.

- Having led the design of a scientific codebase used by others.

What we offer

- Play a key role at a dynamic, fast-growing startup, shaping the technical solutions and products from the ground up.

- Build cutting-edge technology to monitor and control plasmas in real fusion devices, working side-by-side with leading plasma and control experts.

- Great working conditions, located in Lausanne, Switzerland, a city and country known for its high quality of life.

- Competitive salary and equity compensation and benefits including immigration assistance.

title: Data/ML engineer, fusion data
description:
Fusionality is building the measurement, simulation, and control stack for the fusion energy reactors of the future.

Spun out of EPFL’s Swiss Plasma Center and backed by top investors, our technology enables reliable operation, real-time monitoring, and analysis of high-temperature plasmas in fusion devices. We are founded by world-class experts at the intersection of fusion physics, advanced control, and AI (ex-Google DeepMind, EPFL). We are assembling a founding engineering team in Lausanne to build our core technology platform.

We are looking for a Data / Machine Learning Engineer to join our team. This job is for you if you like turning large, messy, heterogeneous experimental data into clean, labelled, trustworthy datasets. You have done this with scientific or industrial sensor data. Familiarity with fusion is a plus but not a strict requirement.

Responsibilities

- Build, maintain and run pipelines that bring experimental fusion data into high quality, consistent, documented, versioned datasets.

- Develop ML-assisted labelling and event detection (e.g. disruptions, MHD activity, diagnostic faults), using weak supervision, active learning and anomaly detection.

- Own data quality and provisioning: provenance, calibration metadata, automated validation. Manage and facilitate access for the rest of the team.

- Work with physicists validating the datasets & labels.

- Work with our computational scientists and control engineers, who build models and controllers on these datasets, and with customers to understand and integrate their data.

Requirements

- Hands-on experience building data pipelines for large scientific or industrial time-series data formats (e.g. HDF5, Parquet, Zarr).

- Proficiency in designing, querying and optimizing SQL and noSQL database systems and familiarity with Time Series databases such as TimescaleDB, InfluxDB.

- Experience in applying ML techniques to time series in Python (PyTorch or JAX): sequence models, anomaly and event detection, semi- or weakly-supervised labelling.

- Solid software engineering habits: testing, reproducibility, data versioning are second nature to you.

- Evidence of independent work at the highest level: a PhD thesis and/or published code that is used by others, or an industry project you owned. You should be comfortable designing data architectures independently from day 1.

- Proficient using Agentic coding and other modern AI technologies to accelerate your work, while remaining accountable for the outcomes.

The following are an advantage but not strictly required:

- Human-in-the-loop labelling tools and workflows.

- Pipeline Orchestration (e.g. Dagster, Airflow, Prefect) and data versioning (e.g. DVC, lakeFS).

- Data from large physics experiments: fusion, accelerators, astronomy, or exposure to fusion data systems (MDSplus, IMAS).

What we offer

- Play a key role at a dynamic, fast-growing startup, shaping the technical solutions and products from the ground up.

- Build cutting edge technology to monitor and control plasmas in real fusion devices, working side-by-side with leading plasma and control experts.

title: Senior C/C++ Low Latency Engineer
description:
Your job 

This role is crucial for our organization. Our Technology team is small and therefore you get a lot of responsibilities and freedom! You are triggered by being faster than the competitors and you like to focus on quality. As you can imagine in a small team, there is a flat hierarchy and everybody is really hands-on to be the best in what we do!

We are looking for senior C/C++ Engineers with extensive knowledge and experience in building, testing, monitoring and maintaining large scale parallel applications and databases. As a C/C++ Engineer at Mathrix in the low latency environment, your focus will be on the code which facilitates the automated trades on various exchanges worldwide.

Our companies’ performance is highly dependent on the performance of our data processing pipelines. You will regularly need to appeal to all aspects of your developers’ skillset to find new and innovative ways to optimize your code. Some examples:

- low-latency networking code for fast communication with exchanges

- context-switch-free code

- design and implement custom data storage structures with minimalistic footprint

- data pipelines using a streaming paradigm

- complex trading logic for the decision engine with the lowest possible compute time

- re-implement existing code using advanced features of the CPU (SIMD)

To accommodate the growth of the company, we spend increasing efforts on the maintainability and manageability of our large, highly optimized and multithreaded codebases while preserving its main purpose (low latency). You will have to maneuver yourself between these worlds to get the best results.

In addition to writing code, the Technology team builds and maintains the global (hardware) infrastructure to facilitate the trading. In your job you will be regularly involved in all aspects of the pipeline and different tech stacks; from hardware compositions, network design to data logging pipelines for the traders and quants.

Who are you 

Due to the growth of our organization, we are looking for more than one C/C++ Engineer. As the new team member, you bring the following skillset:

- extensive and thorough knowledge of C and C++ in Linux

- an understanding of – and the ability to verify - the assembly the compiler will produce from the code you write

- understanding what (GNU/Linux) system calls you invoke will do and cost

- knowledge of x64 hardware and how to use it efficiently

- understanding what storage structures to select or implement given their use (time complexity)

- ability to work with debuggers and profilers

- operative coding (git, documentation)

- ability to absorb from and provide knowledge to the team

- pro-active, a self-starter, honest, flexible and stress resistant

In addition to the above, having a background in one of the specializations below are nice to have:

- experience with network engineering; either (low latency) networking hardware deployment or networking protocol implementations

- experience with Big Data engineering and knowledge of Big Data best practices and implementations best suited for different use cases

What we offer 

- Excellent remuneration (including discretionary bonus)

- Fun and inspiring work environment

- Experienced and knowledgeable colleagues

- 25 vacation days

- Additional benefits: going out for dinner regularly, Friday afternoon drinks, yearly office trip(s), weekly massages, monthly meal allowance

title: Gestionnaire Ressources Humaines
description:
L’humain au cœur de la Maison, contribuez à faire vivre l’expérience Beau-Rivage de l’intérieur.

Niché au cœur de Genève, notre palace emblématique incarne l’élégance, le raffinement et l’excellence du service hôtelier de luxe. Engagé dans un ambitieux projet de rénovation visant à sublimer son héritage tout en redéfinissant les standards contemporains du luxe, l’établissement ouvre un nouveau chapitre de son histoire.

Pour accompagner cette transformation et soutenir nos équipes au quotidien, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Gestionnaire Ressources Humaines H/F .

Votre mission :

Rattaché(e) à la Directrice des Ressources Humaines, vous assurez la gestion RH quotidienne et accompagnez les collaborateurs tout au long de leur parcours au sein de la Maison.

Véritable interlocuteur(trice) de proximité, vous intervenez sur l’ensemble des sujets liés à l’administration du personnel, à la paie, au recrutement et à l’expérience collaborateur.

Polyvalent(e), autonome et organisé(e), vous évoluez au sein d’une équipe RH à taille humaine et contribuez activement à garantir une gestion fiable et rigoureuse, tout en maintenant une relation de proximité avec les collaborateurs et les équipes opérationnelles.

Vos responsabilités principales :

- Administration du personnel : Assurer la gestion administrative des collaborateurs, de leur entrée à leur sortie : contrats, avenants, attestations, certificats de travail, permis de travail et autres documents RH.
- Suivi des collaborateurs : Garantir la bonne tenue des dossiers collaborateurs, la fiabilité des données administratives et leur mise à jour régulière.
- Gestion des absences : Assurer le suivi des absences, vacances, congés et certificats médicaux.

- Communication & Événements internes : Participer à la communication RH ainsi qu’à l’organisation des événements destinés aux collaborateurs.
- Projets RH & Expérience Collaborateur : Contribuer aux différents projets RH et proposer des initiatives visant à améliorer continuellement l’expérience collaborateur.

- Formation : Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une école hôtelière (Bachelor ou équivalent) et avez complété votre parcours par une formation en Ressources Humaines .

- Outils : Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils informatiques et les systèmes d’information RH.

Genau dafür suchen wir dich. 
Wir holen Content und Creative gerade ins Haus. Meta läuft seit August bei uns statt bei einer Agentur. Jetzt suchen wir eine Person, die Verantwortung übernimmt: für unseren Content, für unsere organischen Kanäle und dafür, dass bluu in der Schweiz und in Europa sichtbar wird und wächst.

- Organic Social Growth: Du verantwortest das organische Wachstum unserer Kanäle @bluuwash in der Schweiz. Gleichzeitig baust du sie im EU-Raum aus. Dein Ziel: mehr Markenbekanntheit und mehr Umsatz in jedem Markt.

Du entwickelst Angles und Hooks und schreibst die Ad-Skripte, für unsere eigenen Videos und für unsere UGC-Creator. Du filmst und schneidest selbst. Hinter der Kamera bist du sicher unterwegs. - Organic Content aus dem Alltag: Du filmst Office-, Behind-the-Scenes- und Produktcontent und machst daraus Reichweite auf unseren Kanälen.

- neue Produkte im Markt positionieren und dafür den passenden Content entwickeln

- Content laufend anpassen, testen und weiterentwickeln, je nachdem, was funktioniert

- neue Formate, Kanäle und Märkte ausprobieren

- Erfahrung im E-Mail-Marketing, idealerweise mit Klaviyo

Nice to have: 

- Erfahrung mit dem Ausbau in neue Märkte, zum Beispiel DE oder AT

- erste Erfahrung mit WhatsApp-Marketing

- Erfahrung mit Creator- und UGC-Kooperationen

- Du stehst ab und zu gern selbst vor der Kamera

Das erwartet dich bei bluu

- echte Verantwortung für Kanäle und Märkte, die du selbst prägst

- ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen und echten Entscheiden

- Themen, die du von null aufbaust, zum Beispiel WhatsApp und neue EU-Märkte

Format, Stil und Setting wählst du selbst. Sei kreativ und bring deine Persönlichkeit rein. Wir wollen sehen, wie du denkst, nicht wie perfekt du dich präsentierst.

Im Motivationsschreiben erzählst du uns, warum du zu bluu passt. Im Portfolio zeigst du Content, den du selbst konzipiert, gefilmt oder geschnitten hast, am besten mit ein paar Worten dazu, was funktioniert hat und warum.

title: ML Intern: Optimization Quality & Monitoring
description:
Our common vision

Our mission is to help marketing teams unlock their full growth potential with AI. Our AI-powered attribution creates real transparency, showing how digital advertising investments perform across channels. On that foundation, we optimize budgets so our customers can sustainably grow their bottom line. We support leading European brands across e-commerce, telco, banking, insurance & energy, and many other industries in making their marketing smarter, more efficient, and more impactful.

About the role

Nexoya runs fully automated, AI-driven budget optimizations and simulations for enterprise marketing portfolios across many ad channels. Every result that reaches a customer must be correct, explainable and on time. As our ML Intern, you make sure it is: you monitor pipeline health, check the quality of predictions, optimizations and simulations, investigate anomalies and turn recurring manual checks into reliable tooling. You work closely with our ML engineers and Customer Success, and you see directly how your work shapes our customers' budget decisions.

Your responsibilities

Monitor the automation and assure result quality

- Monitor the automated prediction, optimization and simulation pipelines across customer portfolios and track run health, completeness and timeliness.

- Verify that predictions, optimization proposals and simulation results meet our quality standards before they reach customers: budget shifts, expected KPI changes, channel constraints and funnel-level effects.

- Investigate failed or unexpected runs, identify the root cause (data, configuration or model) and resolve it or escalate it with a clear diagnosis.

Assure the quality of results over time

- Define and maintain plausibility checks for optimization and simulation results, for example for budget planning, seasonal shifts or new channel tests.

- Make sure results are consistent and explainable, so that customers and account managers can trust them without manual checks.

- Compare optimized and simulated outcomes with realized performance, document deviations and feed the findings back to the ML team.

Safeguard data and model quality

- Monitor input data for gaps, anomalies and tracking changes that affect optimization quality.

- Track model fit and prediction accuracy per portfolio and flag degradation early.

- Maintain portfolio configurations such as funnel steps, constraints and target definitions together with the responsible teams.

Automate the operational workflow

- Replace manual checks with Python scripts, validation rules and alerts.

- Build and maintain dashboards that show run status, data health and model performance across portfolios.

- Write runbooks so that operational knowledge is shared, not held by one person.

The impact you will have

- Customers receive optimization proposals and simulations that are correct and delivered on time.

- Issues are caught before customers see them, not after.

- The time the ML team spends on operational work goes down measurably, because recurring steps are automated.

- Customer Success can trust automated optimization and simulation results without checking them by hand.

Your experience and skills

- Recently completed Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or a related field.

- Solid Python skills, including pandas and NumPy, and comfort working with SQL.

- Good understanding of statistics and basic machine learning concepts such as regression, model evaluation and overfitting.

- A careful, structured way of working: you check results before you share them and you document what you do.

- Ability to explain technical findings clearly to non-technical colleagues.

- Fluent English, spoken and written, is a must.

Bonus points

- Experience with optimization methods, for example constrained or non-convex optimization.

- Familiarity with Marketing Mix Modeling, attribution or digital advertising metrics.

- Experience with data pipelines, scheduled jobs or monitoring tools.

- Experience with Git, Docker and cloud environments.

- Fluent in German or Italian.

Your future work life

- Purpose: Your work directly influences how enterprise marketers allocate their budgets.

- Responsibility: You own the quality of a defined part of our automation from day one, with a personal development roadmap and regular feedback.

- Learning: You work alongside experienced ML and data engineers on production systems, not on side projects.

- Culture: A transparent company culture at eye level, where every person is valued and supported.

- Strategy: You take part in shaping company strategy and culture during our quarterly Strategy Days.

- Events: Regular team events, on-site and off-site.

Application process

- Profile review and short phone screen

- Take-home case study

- Case discussion with the ML team

- On-site interview and team evaluation

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation . SEO Strategy & Optimization

You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.

Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. Creative strategy is a core driver of paid social performance: You turn customer insight and campaign data into compelling concepts, run a rigorous testing program and work with creative partners to bring the strongest ideas to market. 

You connect that work to measurable business outcomes, improving conversion and return on investment while making sure every health claim is accurate and approved.

Reporting to the Head of Performance Marketing, you will play a key role in our performance marketing team, working with internal teams and external partners to drive growth.

Work location: Our company operates on a remote-first model. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in Europe. Fluent English and German are a must. Occasional travel to our office in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, or to team events may be required.

Core responsibilities 

- Lead paid social strategy, planning and execution across the US, UK, Germany and other growth markets.
- Develop creative hypotheses based on customer research, market differences and performance data.
- Brief, test and refine ad concepts, messages, formats and landing pages in partnership with creative and product teams.
- Manage campaign budgets, audiences and optimisation across Meta, TikTok and other relevant platforms.
- Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey and conversion rate, from ad click through to purchase.
- Measure performance against acquisition cost, revenue and return on investment and turn findings into clear decisions and next steps.
- Work with clinical, regulatory and legal colleagues to ensure advertising claims and health messaging are accurate and approved.
- Steer agencies and freelancers, set clear priorities and ensure high-quality execution and continuous performance improvement.
Requirements 

Background & Experience 

- At least 5 years of hands-on paid social experience in an international setting, including direct ownership of campaigns and budgets.
- Strong creative strategy skills and a track record of turning insights into ads that perform.
- A data-driven approach to testing, measurement, and decision-making.
- Experience improving conversion rates and managing campaigns against ROI goals.
- Deep knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and experience with other relevant social platforms.
- Ability to adapt messaging and execution across markets while keeping the brand consistent.
- Clear communication and sound judgment when working with sensitive health topics.
- Nice to have: experience in health tech, medical devices, wearables, or subscription products.
Benefits 

What Makes You A Great Fit 

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do: 

Move the Needle — You focus on what truly drives impact for our customers and company. You use data and clarity to guide your decisions and prioritize what matters most. You push boundaries with bold, thoughtful innovation and hold yourself accountable for results.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with high quality. You treat mistakes as learning opportunities, experiment thoughtfully and iterate quickly. You take ownership, act hands-on and always look for smarter, faster ways to get things done, including leveraging AI and new tools.

Team First — You put the team above individual interests, building trust through openness and respect. You encourage healthy debate, challenge directly while caring personally and stand behind team decisions. You act as an owner, stepping in when needed and doing what’s necessary for the team’s success.

- Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies and you can be part of this exciting story.

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role 

As Energetic Materials Engineer in the Warhead team, you will be the technical authority ensuring the energetic materials in our systems are properly selected, tested and qualified for their intended use. You will build Harmattan AI’s expertise in energetic materials chemistry, stability and supplier assurance, so we can safely and repeatedly source and produce energetics as we scale. - Act as the internal reference on energetic materials chemistry, properties and compatibility to guide material selection.

- Assess supplier specifications, process capability and quality requirements to ensure repeatability and traceability, and manage inspections and non-conformances.

- Support warhead and fuze engineers in sourcing and preparing materials for prototype testing, and report results to systems engineers.

- Build qualification frameworks and guidance for the wider team, and contribute to growing an internal materials team.

Candidate Requirements 

- Master’s degree or PhD in Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering or a related field.

- Strong understanding of explosive materials, propellants and pyrotechnics, including explosive safety and hazardous materials handling.

- Hands-on experience with analytical techniques such as DSC, TGA, FTIR and Raman spectroscopy.

- Experience characterizing and evaluating materials in accordance with NATO qualification standards.

- Experience running qualification programs for materials used in pyrotechnic or energetic systems.

- Understanding of materials manufacturing processes and quality controls.

- Fluency in English required.

title: Coördinator taalschakeltrajecten Alphen aan den Rijn
description:
In onze taalschakeltrajecten (onderwijsroute) naar het mbo krijgen jong volwassen inburgeraars in anderhalf tot twee jaar tijd een goede basis om te kunnen starten op én succesvol te zijn op het mbo. Wij verzorgen dit onderwijs en begeleiding kleinschalig en dichtbij huis. Cursisten kunnen bij ons op elk moment starten met de Nederlandse taallessen, samen met inburgeraars die andere inburgeringsroutes volgen. Stilstaan is geen optie. Daarna krijgen zij gefaseerd lessen rekenen, Engels en begeleiding. Deze unieke aanpak vergt een goede en vlekkeloze coördinatie en daarvoor zoeken wij jou!

Taken

Als coördinator taalschakeltrajecten op de locatie Alphen aan den Rijn: 

- Ben je de spil van de taalschakeltrajecten op locatie 

- Ben je verantwoordelijk voor de aanmeldingen en intakes van nieuwe cursisten en een gedegen advies aan de gemeente.

- Zorg je voor een nauwkeurige administratie, waaronder het bijhouden van cursistdossiers.

- Maak je leerplannen en roosters en zorg je voor de informatievoorziening aan cursisten. 

- Volg je het traject van de cursist en zorg je tijdig en secuur – waar nodig in overleg met docenten en studieloopbaanbegeleider – voor het leerplan voor de volgende fase.

- Voorzie jij de studieloopbaanbegeleider van benodigde informatie over onder andere aanwezigheid en roosters en zet rapporten klaar.

- Organiseer jij examenperiodes en zorg je voor een nauwkeurige en vlotte afhandeling van examens en de nodige vervolgstappen.

- Onderhoud je goed contact met cursisten, docenten en studieloopbaanbegeleider en signaleert als er dingen niet goed gaan. 

- Heb je regelmatig overleg met de opleidingsmanager over de zorg en verdere ontwikkeling van processen en kwaliteit van de taalschakeltrajecten. 

- Werk je in een dynamische omgeving waar ook andere inburgeringscursussen worden gegeven en overleg je met collega’s over roosters en andere praktische zaken op locatie.

Vereisten

- Je hebt ervaring met of aantoonbare affiniteit met (kleinschalige) projecten op gebied van NT2, mbo of onderwijs in het algemeen

- Je hebt ervaring met het coördineren en organiseren van onderwijs of andere educatieve projecten.

- Je kan goed zelfstandig werken, maar vraagt tijdig om hulp en kan tegelijkertijd goed samenwerken met collega’s en partnerorganisaties en voor draagvlak zorgen

Benefits

- Echt Nederlands biedt een leuke werkplek, een open en ongedwongen sfeer en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en nascholing waar nodig. De bedrijfscultuur is erop gericht om samen tot mooie resultaten te komen voor onze cursisten, medewerkers en het bedrijf

- 25 vakantiedagen bij een werkweek van 40 uur; 8% vakantietoeslag en reiskostenvergoeding vanaf 10 kilometer

- Een functie waarbij je werkt op locatie Alphen aan den Rijn

- Een eigen laptop en waar nodig telefoon

- Een prettige, ambitieuze, maar informele werksfeer waarin je je snel thuis zult voelen

- De mogelijkheid om door te groeien om meer verantwoordelijkheid te krijgen voor en mee te denken over de (inhoudelijke) ontwikkeling van onze taalschakeltrajecten.

Gecombineerd met de hoge kwaliteit van onze taalcursussen, vinden cursisten bij ons een uitstekende basis voor het nastreven van persoonlijke leerdoelen. Daarmee gaan we verder binnen de nieuwe inburgering. We blijven ons ontwikkelen, samen met onze partners, waaronder de gemeente, maatschappelijke begeleiding en werkgevers. title: AI Engineer - Tech Stagaire
description:
Voor deze rol is Nederlands spreken een vereiste.

Wil jij de "koffie halen" stage overslaan en direct verantwoordelijkheden krijgen bij een snelgroeiende AI-agency? 

Bij Surf Agency ben je geen stagiair die een beetje mag meekijken. Je krijgt verantwoordelijkheden die normaal gesproken bij een CTO liggen: van het ontwerpen van schaalbare AI-infrastructuren tot het bouwen van complexe agents die het verschil maken voor klanten. Wij zoeken een ambitieuze technische student die onze tech naar een nieuw niveau brengt!

Locatie : Rotterdam

Dienstverband : 24-40 uur. Waarvan minimaal 3 dagen op kantoor

Vergoeding : Basisvergoeding

Startdatum : In overleg

Wie zijn wij? 

Wij zijn Surf Agency, een AI-agency uit Rotterdam met één missie: Nederlandse bedrijven efficiënter maken door AI op een praktische manier te implementeren.

Wij kijken met een bedrijfskundige blik naar processen: we analyseren eerst de manier van werken van een bedrijf en maken daarna pas de vertaalslag naar AI. Op die manier slaan wij de brug tussen de nieuwste AI-technologie en het bedrijfsleven. Lees meer op de “over ons” pagina.

Onze cultuur 

Sinds onze start in mei 2025 groeien we hard en bouwen we aan een jonge, dynamische cultuur. Bij Surf Agency vind je geen ‘zesjes-mentaliteit’; wij streven altijd naar het allerbeste resultaat waar we zelf trots op kunnen zijn.

- Pioniers : We brengen een frisse, jonge blik en dagen de gevestigde orde uit door dingen op onze eigen manier te doen

- Ondernemend: We bieden een plek waar je de vrijheid hebt om te ondernemen en mee te bouwen aan een bedrijf in de meest spannende sector van dit moment.

- Inclusief & Open : Een plek waar je kunt groeien, verantwoordelijkheden krijgt en kunt leren.

- Fun & Play : Hard werken is de standaard, maar de balans met plezier is cruciaal; onze vrijmibo’s in Rotterdam zijn daar een vast onderdeel van.

Taken

Je takenpakket is breed en biedt veel verantwoordelijkheid, waarbij prioriteiten in overleg worden bepaald en er ruimte is om te werken aan onderwerpen die jou interesseren.

- AI Solutions: Het bouwen en implementeren van maatwerk AI-oplossingen voor diverse klanten. Dit doen we via de nieuwste Claude en Codex modellen. 

- Agent Development: Het ontwikkelen van zowel interne als externe AI-agents die complexe bedrijfsprocessen automatiseren.

- R&D: Samenwerken met partners aan het lokaal draaien van LLM’s en het optimaliseren van onze cloud-infrastructuur en databases met bijvoorbeeld Supabase.

Verder biedt deze stage mogelijkheden om door te groeien naar werkstudent of fulltime functie.

Wat zoeken wij? 

Wij zoeken iemand die wil bijdragen aan productieklare AI-oplossingen en graag zelf bijleert over nieuwe mogelijkheden met AI. Jij herkent je in minimaal 2 van deze profielen:

- Programmeerkennis: Kennis over Python en/of JavaScript. Ervaring met coderen met AI is een pré. 

- Database : Kennis van databases zoals PostgreSQL en Supabase.

- AI/ML : Kennis van LangChain, RAG-oplossingen en complexe LLM-integraties.

Vereisten

Wie ben jij? 

- Ondernemend : Je bent een zelfstarter die kansen ziet en pakt.

- HBO/WO-student : Je hebt al enige ervaring in het AI-landschap

- Ambitieus : Je wilt meebouwen aan een snelgroeiende start-up.

- Proactief : Je wacht niet af tot anderen je een opdracht geven, maar kan je eigen taken prioriteren en uitvoeren.

- Tech-savvy : Je volgt de razendsnelle ontwikkelingen in AI op de voet en kunt deze vertalen naar code.

- Leergierig : Altijd open om nieuwe skills te leren.

- Je spreekt Nederlands.

Interesse? 
Stuur je CV en een korte motivatie. Heb je vragen? Stuur gerust een berichtje!

title: (Senior) Principal Mendix Developer
description:
Excited to lead teams and architect Mendix solutions that are scalable, future-ready and make a real difference? 

At Valcon, we help organisations across Europe become fit for the future – combining consulting, data and technology to realise real transformation. We work end-to-end: from boardroom strategy to concrete implementation on the work floor. Our approach is pragmatic, fast and collaborative. No buzzwords, just results.

Our culture is defined by ownership, entrepreneurship and continuous learning. We believe in growing together – through mentorship, trust and the freedom to shape your own path. We offer flexibility, challenge, and the opportunity to work on projects that matter.

You’ll join our fast-growing Low-Code capability, with over 100 Mendix professionals across Europe – including 26 experts and 3 MVPs in the Netherlands alone. Our team works on high-impact projects for clients like IND/COA, Prorail, Defensie, BAM, Heineken with a strong focus on collaboration, quality and long-term solutions. Many of our projects are international – such as our recent engagement in Denmark, where our hybrid team (NL, DK, KR) delivers scalable solutions from design to delivery. Whether you want to specialise, coach others or lead engagements: you’ll find the space and support to grow.

Tasks

What will you do? 

As a (Senior) Principal Mendix Consultant, you bring together strategic thinking, platform expertise and strong leadership. You’ll lead multidisciplinary project or DevOps teams with full end-to-end ownership – from uncovering client needs to delivering scalable, future-ready applications.

You take the lead in workshops, architecture and design decisions, translating complex business challenges into impactful IT-solutions – ranging from mobile and workflow apps to data-driven and integrated platforms. Increasingly, you’ll work on solutions that leverage AI, smart automation and advanced integrations to unlock new business value.

Beyond delivery, you’ll play a key role in shaping our Low-Code capability. You help scale teams, raise engineering standards, and contribute to strategy, talent development and internal best practices. As a technical lead, you’re also actively involved in pre-sales, shaping proposals and leading proof-of-concepts for new clients.

Depending on your interests, you can further grow towards strategic client ownership, technical depth or mentoring responsibilities – always with the freedom to shape your own path. 

Among your responsibilities will be the following: 

- Designing, developing and testing innovative Mendix solutions in an agile way.

- Leading multidisciplinary teams and acting as technical lead in delivery projects: guiding architecture, workshops, design decisions, and quality

- Leading and coaching multiple Mendix teams, sometimes across different clients and domains.

- Tackling complex technical challenges and shaping long-term platform strategies.

- Coaching developers and consultants to grow their skills and confidence with the Mendix platform.

- Supporting pre-sales activities and helping shape client proposals and proof-of-concepts.

- Strengthening our Low-Code capability through improved standards, best practices and strategic team development.

Requirements

Experience: 

- A completed Bachelor’s, Master’s or technical HBO degree in Computer Science, Technology, Engineering, Econometrics, Mathematics or a related field.

- At least 4 years of working experience as Mendix specialist/application developer and Mendix Advanced Developer certification.

- Nice to have: Mendix Expert Developer Certification and/or a specialisation in a domain like UI/UX, Architecture or custom (react/java) development.

- Fluent in Dutch and English

- Located in The Netherlands

Benefits

What do we offer you? 

- Personal development: a tailor-made growth path with training, courses, certification and mentoring by experienced colleagues.

- An innovative work environment: collaborate with a team of experts pushing boundaries in data, technology, and consulting.

- Immediate impact and responsibility: you’ll make a difference for our clients from day one and are entrusted with responsibilities that challenge you to bring the best out of yourself.

- Inspiring work culture: a supportive, flexible, and no-nonsense environment that fosters your growth and fully allows you to be yourself.

Additionally, we offer: 

- Competitive employment benefits, including bonuses and expense allowance.

- A company car or mobility budget.

- A workplace that prioritizes and respects your work-life balance (for example by offering you the option of taking a sabbatical or expand the amount of holidays per year).

- An affordable sports membership that allows you to participate in 50 different sports offered by over 10,000 partners.

- The opportunity to work remotely from abroad for 10 days per year.

- A vibrant community that organizes both professional and social events.

Ready to apply? 

Has the above sparked your interest and are you ready to join our innovative and impactful environment? And do our core values – Together, Joy, Curious, Can do, and Integrity – resonate with you?

Our recruitment team would be happy to hear from you! Please apply directly to schedule a coffee meeting at our office first.

title: Adviseur Loopbaan en Mobilteit
description:
Als je goed zorgt voor je mensen, zorgen zij goed voor jou. Deze overtuiging van de oprichter van ADG Dienstengroep vormt de basis van Koersmakers. Koersmakers is een nieuw bedrijf dat werkt aan duurzame inzetbaarheid voor vakmensen, zodat zij maximale regie krijgen over het (werkende) leven. Om dit goed in de praktijk te brengen zijn we op zoek naar een adviseur in de regio Amsterdam/Rotterdam, Noord en Oost Nederland

Omschrijving van het team 

Koersmakers is een jong, maar groeiend team van 9 collega’s. De mobiliteitsadviseurs Annemiek, Celine, Wilco, Miranda, Mariëlle, Dana en Inez, begeleiden ieder in hun eigen regio vakmensen in verschillende trajecten: van spoor 2 re-integratie tot (loopbaan)coaching en van gespreksbegeleiding tot leiderschapstrainingen. Zwaantje ondersteunt hen in de dagelijkse operatie en Sterre is kwartiermaker en eindverantwoordelijk voor Koersmakers.

Taken

Wat ga je doen? 

Als adviseur ga jij in de verschillende trajecten de verhalen, doelen en talenten van hun vakmensen naar boven halen. Op dit moment begeleid je hoofdzakelijk medewerkers in een Spoor 2 re-integratie traject. Tegelijkertijd worden we inmiddels ook steeds vaker gevraagd om vakmensen te begeleiden in (loopbaan)-coaching trajecten en bij gespreksbegeleiding. En die beweging naar preventieve dienstverlening omtrent de inzetbaarheid van vakmensen is precies de stap die ze de komende tijd samen met jou willen zetten. 

In de begeleiding van vakmensen maak je gebruik van passende (interesse)testen, waaronder de Predictive Index. Jij zet vervolgens dat wat iemand wil, drijft en kan, om naar concrete acties om de inzetbaarheid van deze vakmensen te vergroten en behouden. Hierbij houd je rekening met de actuele regels tot Wet Verbetering Poortwachter en de verzuimcyclus van het UWV. Daarnaast ondersteun je de leidinggevenden van de verschillende ADG bedrijven hoe zij samen met hen de regie van vakmensen op het (werkende) leven naar de praktijk kunnen brengen. 

Ze vinden het geen probleem als je geen tot weinig ervaring hebt met het gebruik van onze testen.

Vereisten

Wat ze wel belangrijk vinden: 

- Je hebt ervaring met het uitvoeren van Spoor 2 re-integratie trajecten.

- Je vindt het leuk om te werken aan de duurzame inzetbaarheid van hun medewerkers. Vakmensen die werk doen wat vaak niet gezien wordt, juist als het écht goed gedaan wordt. Schoonmaakmedewerkers, onderhoudsmonteurs, hospitality professionals, BOA’s en zorgmedewerkers. Zij houden Nederland draaiend. Zij doen het voor hén.

- Jij zorgt dat de uitvoering van hun dienstverlening (in geval van Spoor 2 re-integratie) voldoet aan de eisen die de verzuimcyclus en de Wet Verbetering Poortwachter stelt.

- Je legt makkelijk contact met andere mensen, ook in onbekende situaties. Je toont interesse in wie zij zijn en kunt een leidende en sturende rol goed afwisselen met een luisterende en afwachtende rol.

Risketeers is een jonge en ambitieuze organisatie die zich richt op het vinden, opleiden en begeleiden van Young Professionals. We matchen talenten met de juiste klanten, waar ze een passende rol kunnen vervullen. Wij bieden een uniek Talent Development Programma waarin je wordt opgeleid tot een specialist met expertise in AI, data en business binnen de financiële sector. Je leert niet alleen hoe AI-technologieën en data-analyse bedrijfsprocessen verbeteren, maar ook hoe regelgeving zoals de AI Act impact heeft op AI-implementaties en organisaties.

Het bedrijf is gebouwd op de solide fundamenten van twee succesvolle organisaties die hun waarde in de financiële sector al ruimschoots hebben bewezen. Dit garandeert een high-end ontwikkelingsprogramma dat jou als Young Professional voorziet van alle benodigde tools, trainingen en persoonlijke begeleiding. Zo kun je snel uitgroeien tot een succesvolle professional en toekomstige specialist die het verschil maakt in een wereld waar AI, technologie en regelgeving steeds meer met elkaar verweven zijn.

Taken

Wat kun je verwachten? 

Artificial Intelligence (AI) transformeert de financiële sector, maar de komst van de AI Act en strengere regelgeving zorgen voor nieuwe uitdagingen. Hoe zorg je ervoor dat AI niet alleen efficiënt wordt ingezet, maar ook middels verantwoord beleid? Welke AI-use cases leveren de meeste waarde op en hoe breng je naar de praktijk? En hoe versterk je AI-literacy binnen organisaties om technologie optimaal te benutten?

Als AI Business & Data Expert werk je op het snijvlak van AI, data en business en ben jij de schakel tussen techniek, data en business. Je helpt financiële instellingen bij het identificeren en implementeren van AI-oplossingen die bedrijfsprocessen verbeteren en tegelijkertijd voldoen aan regelgeving. Je ontwikkelt AI-use cases, analyseert data en vertaalt complexe AI-technologie naar concrete toepassingen. Daarnaast speel je een cruciale rol in AI Literacy binnen organisaties: je helpt teams beter te begrijpen hoe AI werkt, welke risico’s en mogelijkheden er zijn en hoe ze AI verantwoord kunnen inzetten.

Je werkt nauw samen met IT, Risk en Compliance en zorgt ervoor dat AI-oplossingen niet alleen technisch kloppen, maar ook bijdragen aan strategische doelstellingen. Met jouw kennis van AI, data-analyse en regelgeving maak je innovatie praktisch toepasbaar en zorg je ervoor dat AI-oplossingen realistisch, schaalbaar en effectief worden geïntegreerd binnen de organisatie.

- AI Business Analyst

Bovendien ben je klaar om jouw analytische en technische vaardigheden in te zetten om complexe vraagstukken op te lossen met behulp van AI-technologieën.

Je hebt een relevante HBO- of WO-opleiding afgerond, zoals Econometrie, Finance, Risk Management, Business Administration/Economics of een gerelateerd vakgebied. Daarnaast heb je een sterke affiniteit met AI-governance, financiële regelgeving en risicomanagement, en beschik je over kennis van AI-modellen, data-analyse en machine learning.

Waarom kiezen voor Risketeers?

description:

-

-

What we offer

- 
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- 
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- 
Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- 
Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- 
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

What you’ll do 

- 
Build safety systems: Design, develop, and scale automated moderation systems, abuse detection capabilities, and guardrails for AI agents across ElevenLabs’ products.

- 
Respond to emerging threats: Partner closely with the Investigations team to identify emerging abuse patterns, understand evolving threats, and continuously improve existing safety systems, detection mechanisms, and guardrails to address new risks.

- 
Own production infrastructure: Build and maintain a growing ecosystem of internal safety services, taking ownership of their architecture, deployment, reliability, monitoring, and ongoing operation.

- 
Bring ML models into production: Partner closely with ML engineers to deploy and integrate fine-tuned and proprietary ML models into production safety systems, ensuring they operate reliably and efficiently at scale.

- 
Build end-to-end solutions: Develop backend services, APIs, internal tools, and user-facing interfaces that enable effective moderation, safety operations, and policy enforcement.

- 
Collaborate across teams: Work closely with Product, Legal, and Safety Policy teams to translate business, regulatory, and policy requirements into scalable engineering solutions.

- 
Product: Understand and navigate the tradeoffs between product growth, user experience, and platform safety.

- 
Legal: Translate legal and regulatory requirements into practical, scalable safety systems.

- 
Safety Policy: Collaborate on how safety policies are implemented technically, while helping inform policy decisions through an understanding of engineering capabilities and constraints.

- 
Shape our technical direction: Contribute to architectural decisions and help define how our safety infrastructure evolves as our products, users, and safety challenges grow.

Requirements 

- 
5+ years of software engineering experience building and operating production systems.

- 
Strong backend engineering experience, including designing APIs, working with databases, and building scalable services.

- 
Proficiency in Python and experience with modern backend frameworks.

- 
Experience building and maintaining distributed systems and cloud-based applications.

- 
Comfortable owning systems end to end, from technical design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance.

- 
Experience working across different parts of the stack, with the ability to build internal tools or frontend interfaces when needed.

- 
Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to navigate ambiguous requirements and make pragmatic engineering decisions.

- 
Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers and non-technical stakeholders across different functions.

Bonus 

- 
Experience building Trust & Safety, content moderation, fraud detection, or abuse prevention systems.

- 
Experience building guardrails or safety infrastructure for AI agents and LLM-based applications.

- 
Experience deploying and integrating ML models into production applications.

- 
Familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP).

- 
Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.

- 
Experience with React or other modern frontend frameworks.

- 
Experience with real-time data processing, event-driven architectures, or technologies such as Kafka and Redis.

Location 

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.
